New Jersey Purges Noncitizen Voters
New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill confirmed a Motor Vehicle Commission [software error](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLGOmDAQRL_GdEZmWQNXuEhDd2lTIh9eYCXjRbYDp3x9xC9cN9PM6L0_n8un58hp_-1PclzKEiQsm3wnesolMXL58uEtm-SaFzAwaDNq6Be_Vr5pQd8EZ6Gbtqkh140TTrYDsM3hEK2loUf000YmAI4DbR8mdBSmfgRo2L17ZgQ0xhjoWw8fqx0Qse_py_qg0Py9gq_UciocqKwi1yWRK6-llbw30R21XkX1vxTMCubnedrHl4PTXiXRtz85UW5XORXML4eCefXn5XlPb8bBjjChgrkclDPHqDOdcpMejDE6SVq58j9KRd9SKessMRYdzltTzpIVzE124Xr4dTWMCs1-eo7vY1N_avR28D8AAP__yBiJEQ) improperly registered roughly 6,600 noncitizens between 2023 and 2024. The state conceded that [fewer than 400](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2unDAQRp_GdEZmbH62cJGGbtOmRAYPMCuwkce7JHn6K-u-wS2PRpqj7_x5Tk9HB4XttzvREvPko5_W-DfgzVc8DuLZ-QJrTDlNoKCTqpegJ7dk-uBkXOVtC82wDhXaph_M0DYAbbVb0wzm4WFWq37oZZ297jvUutHt3KvB64ps-ad6MEopBbp28FjazhijNc6t88Ko9-VdxpoCk0deYryueFCmheuYtuqwe84XC_1LwChgvO-7vh3vFLYcQ6YTuV7iKWAsIwSMxShgfL2PAs33Qb4wMf6TKwXPsuuUkiGGhTL9x8Ay4UacMaGXn5hR7u_gE3ouRGETMFbJ-uum0qvrhVHb6ego4ir_tOrHwlcAAAD__294igI) of them actually cast ballots in past elections. Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon promptly opened a federal review, giving Trenton five business days to hand over records as the DOJ presses its suit for the state's unredacted voter file. The White House called it [vindication for](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2upDAQhE9jMiPTmL-AYBOyt-mGqMEN0yPGjdye4e2efsUVXlhSqVTf9-dr_kI-OO6_8UUjq85BwrzJd6RLTzkO1gXDHTZJOc3goLWus1DPuGb-0OyxCGMDVb_1BY1V1_u-qQCa4jEOtcdlw9A6P2xdPwx95RxsrloC9svWFjzee64D75xzUJcIw9q03vu6pqXBYLx7nwEzlRyVA-kqcp5ycOZVS0l7cYyPnE819S8Dk4Hpuq7yQn1w3LNE-sYXR0rlKi8D081hYHq-NfNKBibfNn1T1wamIE-7yKGZko102Sclpb_2wEvfnG2UuHLmfxTtR-5Oop01J8wsUW1gXeVDiYKBqUhjOC--3bWd8W5_IR_3gyL_1PBnhP8BAAD__880kOY) the SAVE America Act -- and a rebuke to years of Democratic insistence that noncitizen voting simply never happens. ★★★
House Passes NDAA, Sports Amendment
The House cleared the fiscal 2027 National Defense Authorization Act in a razor-thin [216-212 vote](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL_ynSAQhZ8GOxxc8c8tKNLY_dKmdFZYlAyCw-K9SZ4-Yx4h5TnFOd98P77WLwwxpP07nmQC8-qyW33-lejDV44x8IbuCT6XWlZQMEo1SehXtDW8adXYODNAN_u5IdNNs56HDmBoDoOK_Kvzwzhu_ehho65_qbmbcbQKkbommGdPTaCVUgr6FuFlh1Fr3fe0DeiEVvflsFIbEgdHbHO-rhxDDZbbXPYmmqPWi0X_TcAiYPl5c60HPcStzaeAZc9vKumkVAUsNqe9ELOA5cg3k7yQmVgmrCEnjNKRp8Qk8a5HLuHPv16irdIHthjlb8IiQcHUFOOuT3gUjZPQaj8xxOezqf8r8m3gbwAAAP__qy2IOw), sending the Pentagon policy bill to the Senate. Several vulnerable Democrats broke ranks to back an amendment [barring biological males](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLsO3CAURL_G7rDYC_hRUKRxt2lTWpiH90pgEJe18_mRpeQHUo40mjM6v97b22DE8_hpktdItLnstpB_n_6mkmNE2o17Qsi11Q04jIxPDMRmbMPLb9L0Tit4zWHuvX5Ns5zVC0D1Hy25krsCHxYJ0xKs5WIMIixiUTYIO_eonz0-geSccxCDgcWqUUophN-VcZ3k3-JM8wOehM6TzbmUHLGhpSHXo4_601qhTvzoYO1gve97-Ht_sDl1sP6rd7Be33j6avbomfMp22oasRCxsDsnfxKjkmsjduXm2QMiPA9GmDCaynaMkVhC13xNxGLOqa_alRsfTePUSX4kg_Hh9u1_ZV4a_gQAAP__DkGK5A) from girls' sports at military-run schools -- a striking reversal for members who opposed similar bills just last year. In all, six Democrats supported final passage while seven Republicans, including Thomas Massie and Chip Roy, voted no. With midterms looming, the [votes showed](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2u5CAQhE-DM0ZMg382INjE2dt0Q6sN7XFL2CCa8du5_cpXeFlVUvXp-_u1fCEnPl9_8CDPIkvMcdnyv5O-peSUWFaMd9lybXUBA4M2owa7YGh80eKwi76H57RNHfnnOLmpfwL03e5Hi0TT08EwjRDNChsOvRt6G1eDSFPH_t4zIzhjjAH7QPgV-sE5Zy2tPUblzLtEbPTgUziShJxLyYkbB3nk-uqS31srouxvBbOCOSKnT8CUqD5CPhTM94WC2Yx3tgrmSuW9Jg54io505FCxiQ41i-iCtX104pNEnxFRC16kMTR95Ua67flA0QeKMOn1XcNOrelQ8SRd80fB3FUfyzff5oZROfM6kNON0rWf-r08_A8AAP__LoSOGg) how sharply the transgender-sports fight now cuts against the left. ★★★
Judge Tosses Minnesota Sanctuary Suit
Trump-appointed U.S. District Judge Eric Tostrud [dismissed every claim](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDGupDAQRE8DmZExZjCBg03IZtMNUYMbpkfGbdlm2L39Cun_C_ywpFLV0_vznJ9AnsL-Gw60lPPs2M0b_w145cjeU17A3WHjVNKspHoIOQjVzbAW-uCsoXa2V63ZTI22HYw2fatUX78smkHDaPSmRt0a57ZB4yrNMqJp5TLqmuy9JwelpZRSdQ2oce0fWuuuw6UHV2l5RgcFGwqZHOaVOUb2VGjNDae99vZVSsxV96tSU6Wm67qaL_xm5aNS03e9UlNJ5xEFxMgUCjrxPt2OonCK6BizcPwWHq58UhEHhYCZC4gMYS0npH-CjoP2BIU4iHR6zHWyLl50a3oMlZb7AeTv37r8VObHqv8BAAD__y_piyc) in the Justice Department's lawsuit against Minnesota, Minneapolis, St. Paul and Hennepin County. In a 56-page opinion, Tostrud ruled the challenged [sanctuary policies](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDFuhDAQRU9jOpAZ7IUtXKSh27Qp0WAbmJWxEWMguX1EjpDyNf_pv6_X8EIKFOdPXL0h5sElN0zpO_qLtxQC8YjuhinteR9AwqOUbQnNgDbT6QeFhTMa6m7qCm_qtlOdrgF0sRhVj_Xo9AhOTug6_6wb3aFtlO6mUU-6IHPvyRaUlFJCUyE8rX4opZrGjxqdUPLYHGZfUWRynm1K25YCZbJcpX0uglly3lg0HwJ6Af11XdWFvFCcc4qZVs-VTauA_j4hoL-NAvr3Ef5AQL9SjJ5TRi4Zo80H7j_lLbHkueRjP-n0pUvv0i4Ygo-zF9AXu3HbRXehRyuUnFekcKuK_N-Op4HfAAAA__80w4ZM) regulate only state and local officials and neither command nor obstruct federal agents. The decision is a setback for the administration's campaign to force blue-state cooperation with ICE, though DOJ is widely expected to appeal. State leaders defended the laws as tools that keep immigrant communities willing to talk to local police, while federal attorneys argued the distinction between "impeding" and "refusing to help" is a dodge that lets a real crisis fester. Expect the fight to land at the Eighth Circuit.

**Your Cutting Board is a Major Health Risk** [Did you know your kitchen cutting board could be poisoning you?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbGOnDAQhp_GdKzM2AZTUCRZbXe5FJFSosEz7FkxGGFzl8ePWFCy9XX-5htbv_z_eulf0Ac_37_jxJ1PqadI_Rj_zPyRlhiCTwPSDmNc89qDhLqUTQmqR5f9O_caC-oMVHa0BXdVY7U1FYAp3jqmGoBVReNonaK2cW2FemjZ0iDHAQvf7e_JBrSUUoK6ILTO1FprpXgwSELLbSHMfPFz8sTJxbgsMfjsXbrE9V6E7i3nJQn1RcBNwC1wYBd-X1ycBNw01ax5cOU4Kltqxaa04KoSjdWD1VWL2gh1czgt6O9z70moq2i-Pg-aq4B6wRWnw72aqnwFI0-xDcetnz--Cai3PPUpbqvjY_mJH-s7Z16n__ZB_9zE5Lcne_LD4xkOz0wBZ-L1mJ3n5lqsHS0ffi-uboSW9wl92H-jyJ-t972DvwEAAP__mlWwGw) Shocking new studies reveal that plastic and wooden boards harbor dangerous bacteria like E. coli and salmonella... even after a good scrub. Those tiny grooves and cracks become breeding grounds for germs, especially after cutting raw meat. But it gets even scarier: plastic boards actually shed invisible microplastics into your food every time you slice and dice. These toxic particles can build up in your body, with unknown long-term effects. Why risk your family's health when the solution is simple? Discover how Tivano keeps your food safe today. Strong intensity among Republicans keeps the number from slipping further.

Turnout and candidate quality in a handful of swing districts look poised to decide House control.

Our campaign to register new voters -- along with turning out all these voters -- are the two most important things we're doing between now and November.
Vote-suppressing state legislatures are gearing up to pass more restrictive laws. Congress is paralyzed and beholden to the president. Beating our voter registration goal -- again -- to register new voters might be our best hope to turn the tide so we can protect and expand our right to vote.
The math is simple: Every $3 can help register a new voter. Can we count on you to chip in $36 and help register 12 new voters, Team? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=072326_2&amount=36]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SAVE America Act would crash voter registration drives [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=072326_2&amount=36]
Team -- the SAVE America Act would eviscerate our fundamental right to vote. So, of course, Donald Trump is pushing for this zombie legislation again, months after we thought it was dead.
The MAGA movement knows that this bill -- from the original SAVE Act to all the various clones -- is the easiest way to deny our right to vote and preserve their power. That's why Trump keeps calling for its passage.
Voter registration is the quickest response to voter suppression legislation. Opponents of voting rights have seen how pro-democracy groups like ours have mobilized new voters in the face of suppression, so they're now targeting the work of pro-voting groups to stop our ability to register new voters .
We're kicking our efforts to register voters ahead of the midterms into high gear. The math is simple:
➜ It costs us around $3 to register a new voter
➜ That means for every $30,000 we raise, we could register 10,000 new voters
➜ Polls show a major shift going on, and this work can truly impact 2026's elections
Not to mention that the more people who vote, the more our government looks like us and not the privileged powerful .
Will you chip in $36 or more today to help register 12 new voters? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=072326_2&amount=36]
GIVE $36 RIGHT NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=072326_2&amount=36]

There's so much on the line in these midterms , with just months to go before Election Day. Registering more new voters this year could make the difference between opponents of voting rights staying in charge to codify voter suppression for the next decade or having the votes we need to pass sweeping new voting rights laws.

subject: How we fight back against the pink haired activist librarians
body:
We must take back the culture| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
| | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpslpzeo69yXgvsMg_hWtvIDfEmVEQBfVBXm6oS8AK-LP5MMPTemalpWQrNUftk85iuPh2x28upTfAz5FXx8zNo3Ji7C9k7ofsIPUHr_5GKy-SAPW-pbMAbOqmpDPgy2GiGS6EUZkXcsmWdVbPXgRlxR55uNd-NLVntRgDuFlFef0nAq9uRzK3lcuOIaxNmbJa0vk3J1zKiWxkf3q98hItlBbbtHqfpomWQwUJynm2iM4Jw-FpqI2C12anW8B9e93Iogl3txfdHcVNVp4JJjN19hl9DzHsYTU6AoAIW9q-wxhgbWv2gs6GE2Bp2swiBb3sqzOlRry7_QVOfYWQHaDxAQoTR_VruBvuHcdDaEnXdBlLpjaXZygrhTCVskEFRjfdy0T4Dp-DdMhIhbg5qCav48o2kiS7rjAEqunhfy-rtEMXR_gn2oj33Kifg8Pk8cjQOTrE0MKJhxKcJHZlJ7P6NA%3D%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpKiIRXDlTrIPQeJSpDQE7i50rbLmiNYg0luNfl_2G48O-OtOCS6-hoX4fHblcJTRsAOnrYnNcKFYg_AIW5RnEYGwZCNbrgBQ4PcQAiYd77VKNLsl9gRhJOxCiJMCo-SHE3ZpYI2J6YZI3dhfECwqiqFsbCR7kllSUJj3l0_K_Io1Ndi01dR-qhKwIkvhtwzJCJJu26MN9DTf7HrCObYbUYoqnoMePuV5wKhfLn5zqoKynfLhcRGoA4KsNFJSvk5A_m5Z4nGjY4K8577xDa2BI34iTegYLhWSJIGmBy7-weSEgzoJiKe2tMW0oXzbkQybDoJmPk7LVT83-ktaK6YsE6FPLmXMfPFQqKnWtICe3PcIQ8IONC6yxVm5fturSKvtAHSioFl6ztV7IDxb2cDUjh4Htjf5JoVSSennDlJyVmI1-18dIqFAmwxytTsaoC1MicSJ8lzehA8NE8qH8I3SJ9Q%3D%3D)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!_**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpNfU8p3QmymM2XxR4l59i71znjiuvgIVpRiv-CwoNBrtrq0VR_2tYk43JbgMF_OajL4EoF1lF7OAo7lYfJcsmEMCQAJUFtg_6acjDUqRcRlFrDqZYMGNIda2gS2WbYi0F8Y2fkTdV4fynKGCf_0RaOST9PettSF8NRq1yw58VLIPScikjpXtuWryzB_IZYmTWbHaGw5nbMQybEh47ampxNs5V8POfiC2xEM-7rV8ebWBJH2BhtnmqHOIZLuNNc0osbr-EpgbbM4Fm_VB_T99kpUJwwmh5wMF0_mfCVLIjyzXxMRAPl-HcbZJjA6OB0uDu-bvtB9BqojDzJdmviQfjOGP-X1yPlgs8eWI-_IWrUV8Ty2g-YaJd1OP73E9AEg_-s9b9l9t8S0Iu6b6NBzx2JqgId7rLFchND6GoEoppgDWA_OuobczzzJA8CZWqx5VcXbexJeu31_WfAT4f_e2uoA%3D%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. _**[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpiZu2gv0KVvpbI36dK1LX9RZN0K5F2wjj2Y5vn1JDUmp2JapCdXzLuxtcJfz7ttcFYXfs6R4T7eYoQwL56SH7M40oMeYIkRwa8zzZWwAKMNoa7klC7ibz5pWoFnQU6Y3qyvKDzsJsHRrQnxW8I4RTO5hO-iLGzULkjBlnyCCgnjSTBN67tlw3pZn_aBzlDgIUpw4uhf5VFQxa3cH5UC2629DTYdVrn_hlG2mJoxtLpet0h1pU_B4mC45bfjKZTE3NWNBwgLdaGL2p2Viw5ZOJiudsxEglDgX_3u0ZalG7BoHoquXHOM5EQMlvMfwivF1z2We_fdmCOFL6fxl8rbi0QroviD1tIY1p_9FulzLat-UwAgAkdhbzZFu3OHy_mnzERKsrLz8Wa1pHzh-k39gc8_OwS5ZOSm0_Qa61W--PMZii9DBNESBbXzriIULTfWqqM6mnKObAm3ez-ol5RCDRMg%3D%3D)**_ The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. _**[That’s why I’ve teamed with a very special non-profit called BRAVE for Good to make this year’s “See You at the Library Day” a bigger success than ever.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpZMj02BV4n-0WyGLELTqh1soByE-TrWCVUP5P5E0gMl86LO0d48xi09Pye8uByOv3oZejTXd9ziDlN6vKF0SaD-jROmcGiuT10BxBnaKM9pd6HU4_fhQ5qzAeUeRaWEwcV7XMa-Skfq81BaX0mcEjnCko9KK6_A0EOrKM_qdeZs7em1oUoea04_zv1ZC9RWQoFoRcwiQdA0PHNolaUwCjELCv8HSsI8Rv1f3qEfvHm1nq0kgw9nUwRPG7aFMd6OLMeFNnupcI6zW6-QzlU1qU0lyiwuanLMRt-Q1Z03DSBUzlbxsK4bRB3MJ9EYpW7J5VxnccKwYIl3vzYpst2JVota2vUate0MZqftC6_dJSaGs5Zlki6hAKUvdzGNrPr4d-CRXKwq7NX04H32rFgY-HtsZMKT0eEG5VRojzTMCQb2-D0IzUv6xDicTjBYJp61eSzi36wBSOg6fOHj9d2JgCXw%3D%3D)**_ **BRAVE for Good** was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. clean_body: We must take back the culture| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical. | | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. name: Francesca Hong
subject: Four myths
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
I’m asking you to believe your eyes and ears
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260723-3073)
Peter,
This one’s a long email, but it's important.
We saw a lot of polls yesterday. Today I want to cut through the chatter and recognize what is one of the most pivotal moments in our campaign’s fight for recognition and legitimacy. Let me be clear: **There is no data-driven evidence to back up the claim that I am unelectable. The Marquette Law School poll made that abundantly clear.**
[Please consider a contribution and help us fight this narrative.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260723.gaEfdW&refcode=em20260723-3073&t=1&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD) We can’t afford to play it safe—not with families across the state struggling to pay their bills.
**Myth #1: I am unelectable.**_The Marquette Law School poll from yesterday has me in a statistical tie with Tom Tiffany._ There’s no shocking evidence that has me down, no damning numbers that show I can’t win. All of that fuss, and my numbers are practically identical to others in the field. It’s just talk. Next time you hear it, ask them to back it up with evidence.
**Myth #1: I am unelectable.**_The Marquette Law School poll from yesterday has me in a statistical tie with Tom Tiffany._ There’s no shocking evidence that has me down, no damning numbers that show I can’t win. All of that fuss, and my numbers are practically identical to others in the field. It’s just talk. Next time you hear it, ask them to back it up with evidence.
**Myth #2: If I am nominated, we will lose the legislature.** There is no evidence to support this conclusion. Wisconsin voters, famously, split their tickets _a lot._ This myth sounds scary, but we know from 2024 that it’s not true. In fact, our massive coalition will _drive_ turnout for down ballot candidates. Showing up for candidates in purple districts—cities and towns—like I have, is how you increase turnout in November! Our movement is winning back voters who have given up on the Democratic party, the system, our democracy.
**Myth #3: Wisconsin is “different” and will not elect a Democratic Socialist.** This blatantly ignores Wisconsin’s progressive heritage, our working-class values, and the real issues this election will be decided upon. I’ve been talking about data centers, the cost of living, the price of gas—long before the Marquette Law School poll showed us that those were the most important issues. The voters are clear, they want a Governor who will deliver on affordability. There have never been more perfect conditions for Wisconsinites to choose the working-class candidate.
**Myth #4: The only electable candidate is a white man.** Current polling seems to indicate that this is the least accurate myth of them all.****
I’m asking you to believe your eyes and ears. So many of you have shown up for me across the state. Look what we’ve already achieved. We’re listening to Wisconsin voters, and it's working.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260723.gaEfdW&refcode=em20260723-3073&t=2&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD)_Check out the crowd at the Vilas/Oneida County Dems Forum earlier this month!_
**[As always, a contribution to our campaign means the world to me—please consider digging deep.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260723.gaEfdW&refcode=em20260723-3073&t=3&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD)** We have the momentum. We’re on top. But we can’t lift our foot off the pedal.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260723.gaEfdW&amount=5&refcode=em20260723-3073&t=6&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD)**
With gratitude,
Francesca
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_fh_footer?refcode=em20260723-3073&t=7&refcode2=3073_105371_e53kwD&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD)**

Donald Trump is breaking the law again, and I’m suing him again — for the 79th time in fewer than 79 weeks.
Here’s what he’s doing this time:
The federal government provides billions of dollars in grants to states to help us prepare for and respond to catastrophic disasters. Trump is using those critical emergency grants to try to bully state and local governments into adopting his anti-immigrant and anti-democracy agenda.
These grants are administered by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and FEMA — and this isn’t the first time they’ve tried to play this dangerous game.
Twice before, they’ve threatened to withhold emergency preparedness funding unless states agree to support the President’s political agenda, twice before they’ve been challenged, and twice before they’ve lost in court.
I’m co-leading a coalition of 24 attorneys general and two governors to challenge the Trump administration’s unlawful tactics once again, and once again, with the law on our side, I believe we will prevail.
The reality is that Trump has so little support for his mass deportation agenda and his baseless election fraud conspiracy theories that he’s resorted to leveraging critical funding to try to force states into adopting his policies.
It’s basically blackmail, and it’s against the law.
I’ve said it 78 times before, and today I’ll say it again: Donald Trump is not above the law — so I’ll see him in court.
If you’re with me, I’m asking for your support to keep this fight for justice and accountability going. Will you contribute any amount right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]

subject: A sham case, a Qatari jet, and a dropped criminal probe
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Last week, a federal judge ruled that Donald Trump's “settled” lawsuit against the IRS — the one that ended with his acting attorney general handing him and his entire family sweeping protections from tax audits — was nothing more than a sham case.
The judge found that the case was brought for an improper purpose: to give judicial legitimacy to a “settlement” that was not based in the law or reality. And that because the IRS falls under the control of the Executive Branch, there was “never a question as to who would prevail.”
Essentially, Trump’s settlement amounted to self-dealing. A backroom arrangement, dressed up as a legal settlement, that could shield Trump from a tax bill exceeding $100 million.
This administration is straight-up corrupt, and over the last few weeks that corruption has been on full display:
Trump’s DOJ shut down a criminal investigation into Abbott Laboratories' contaminated baby formula, despite prosecutors saying they had enough evidence to charge the company. This was after Abbott had donated $500,000 to Trump's inaugural fund.
And now it’s been reported that just before the DOJ dropped its investigation, Trump loaded up on Abbott stock. ( This is exactly why we need a stock trading ban for the White House and Congress! )
And then there's that infamous Qatari jet. Trump officially took his first trip on a plane gifted to him by the Qatari government — a plane that cost American taxpayers hundreds of millions of dollars to retrofit for security (at least as far as we know, since the Air Force still hasn't released the final price tag).
Amid all of that, this federal court ruling about the IRS lawsuit shows what’s possible when one branch of government does its job and stands up to this blatantly corrupt administration.
Democrats in the House have been working to do the same, but Republicans have repeatedly refused to join us to do anything about the corruption. So long as they control the House, Trump will keep dealing from both sides of the table — and the American people will keep footing the bill.
I will continue to do every single thing I can to fight back against whatever this administration throws our way. Are you with me? If so, please chip in towards my re-election campaign’s July fundraising goal now to help us fight back. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]

When I moved to Tennessee, I didn't have a clear idea of what was next.
This community gave me room to work and learn, to build a life step by step. That opportunity changed everything for me, and it's the reason I believe so deeply that America should still be a place where people can start with little and still move forward.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7610c529-ab0a-4c75-a1fa-97e5a7dea80a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**That belief is why I 'm worried about where we're headed, so I'm stepping up to change it (and you can [join our mission here.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8bd4f464-9b43-4d88-ad3d-6d3305a5082c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))**
Opportunities don't vanish overnight. We've watched it be chipped away when healthcare gets harder to access. It has deteriorated time and time again through bills destroying wages and upping costs. The current administration is holding Americans in place, and worse yet this specific seat, held by my opponent Scott Desjarlais, has been completely complicit.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2d8aa00c-4400-48cd-8e91-106beb2cc135?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If you believe America should still work for people starting from nothing, help me keep this campaign going. [Chip in $10 HERE to help our mission.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8bd4f464-9b43-4d88-ad3d-6d3305a5082c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[DONATE HERE](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8bd4f464-9b43-4d88-ad3d-6d3305a5082c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Serving on the Nashville Metro Council since 2023 has only reinforced my beliefs. I see every day how policy choices affect whether families can stay afloat and whether seniors can get care. **That 's why I believe in Hometowns over Headlines.**
It's not a slogan. It's a commitment to keeping opportunity real for the next person who arrives here with nothing but a willingness to try. If that future matters to you, support this fight.
### **Why I 'm Running**

body:
Rank and file Republicans ALWAYS fall in line with Trump.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rxgfFOHCdcUkaN88EG7O9G7JFxKGezKfSo3yNUTVIu6aMDQgZjV2bskgJUOUIez_Ky-NXFWMaVqxAZhRdMQvVb3fQ2Ng61ypD_lVRt71cFgK-9fBBzePrm1-j0NJ0_NTOF-t_nwN2nuxvXJ86LNN4kbbY71DKs7csK9JNJJ8tEtMGj0b77aa9WPZUx4ZeKkarHxIfR0vXZyWVe4zCpgJMsBhxBT8BcK2azfcCFOryS0=&c=NIVfioPFfFIVS4qzwbmT9NL9EfOTpjQcR6IAA_z_P2T8yU-lcE6Kwg==&ch=JUw_fO5nreqzYLPUo9GIt-vMEWOkHkxfqkaNgg0BVM_RppqxyDlx4w==)

|
Peter,
The Mouth of Sauron, Karoline Leavitt, has spoken: Donald Trump's "patience is running out" with Senate Majority Leader John Thune on his inability to force through Trump's voter suppression bill the SAVE Act.
But Thune seems to also be losing patience, which is either a very good sign or a signal that Trump will threaten his position as Majority Leader next to get what he wants.
Thune fired back at Trump in a veiled comment aimed at Leavitt:
"Well maybe she or somebody else ought to get on the phone and get the votes, right?" Thune told reporters. "It's 50 around here. And, so, instead of pointing the finger at Republicans, they might think about going after the people who are stopping it on the floor, which is the Democrats."

We helped save the Democratic majority on the PA supreme court last year by working to reelect three Democratic justices up for retention. But more importantly, each of those justices were steadfastly committed to the rule of law, democracy, and to free and fair elections.

Individuals, federal committees, corporations, and labor unions may contribute to TPPAC, Inc.’s non-contribution account without limit. | In 2025, Elon Musk spearheaded a corrupt scheme to entice select voters in Wisconsin with a $1 million payout who pledged to help Republicans try to win the hotly-contested State Supreme Court race.

---
| The Commissioners found “probable cause” that Musk broke state laws against election bribery in an illicit scheme to “induce” voters to vote in the Supreme Court election.

name: Defenders of Wildlife
subject: Wildlife Wins: Riding along the range
body:
Positive news about our wild world, delivered straight to your inbox!

Positive news about our wild world, delivered straight to your inbox!
                  

                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5798022/38SyG9Xl)

Dear Defender,

Incredible things are happening in the world of conservation every day, thanks to dedicated people and their supporters. Each month, we’ll bring you uplifting stories about wildlife and wild places!

 

Range Riders Help People and Wolves Share the Landscape

Gray wolves have been reintroduced to Colorado, bringing the species back to lands where they once roamed. Now as Coloradans and gray wolves learn to navigate a shared landscape, range riders have emerged as a way to keep the peace between livestock ranchers and wildlife.

Range riders are sentinels on horseback, traveling the landscape and tracking down wolves to maintain boundaries without the need for lethal removals. Defenders helps fund some of these riders in Colorado, where they serve in the role as a way to give back to their local community. Learn more about how these riders help humans and wolves coexist! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5798023/38SyG9Xl)

Kemp’s Ridley Sea Turtles Are Making a Comeback

Kemp’s ridley sea turtles, once teetering on the brink of extinction, have been making a comeback over the past 30 years. A wave of action has helped see these endangered sea turtles on the path to recovery, from people taking action on beaches where they nest to Endangered Species Act protections and international conservation efforts.

Our Southeast Representative Katherine Sayler recently shared how Kemp’s ridley sea turtles have been making their recovery (https://support.defenders.org/s/5798024/38SyG9Xl), as well as tips on how we can help them. And you won’t want to miss this piece on what to do if you find other turtle species nesting in your yard (https://support.defenders.org/s/5798025/38SyG9Xl) during their summer nesting months!

Scientists Celebrate 30 Years of Black-Footed Ferret Reintroduction

Black-footed ferrets were once so close to the edge of extinction that we thought they’d already disappeared. That was until a small population was discovered in a corner of Wyoming – and scientists kicked off a historic effort to save this species.

This month marked 30 years since captive-bred black-footed ferrets were reintroduced (https://support.defenders.org/s/5798026/38SyG9Xl) to habitat in Conata Basin and Badlands National Park. After decades of work by Defenders and allied groups, these ferrets are going strong in the wild!

Legislation Introduced to Reverse Attack on Endangered Species in the Gulf of Mexico

Following action by the Endangered Species Committee – colloquially known as the “God Squad” for the impact of their decisions on imperiled wildlife – to bypass Endangered Species Act protections in the Gulf of Mexico, Representative Don Beyer (D-VA) introduced the Protect Gulf Life Act.

If passed, this bill would reinstate protections for animals like endangered Rice’s whales and other marine species that would be harmed by a reckless expansion of oil and gas development in the Gulf. Learn more about the bill here! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5798027/38SyG9Xl)

Defenders relies on members like you power ongoing conservation efforts nationwide. Learn how you can lend your support and make a difference with us! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5798028/38SyG9Xl)

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)

| | Friends, My Democrat opponent is ratcheting up his attacks on me, which is par for the course in a hotly contested campaign like ours, but one of his latest videos really made me laugh.
It was an odd video about his qualifications that was anchored by an argument that because I've never been an environmental lawyer, I'm not fit to be Michigan's Attorney General. Much to my surprise, in this video about how he is qualified to be our state's top law enforcement official, he never once mentioned public safety.
I've spent the last 30 years serving the people of Mid-Michigan as a prosecutor. I have prosecuted and secured convictions in some of the most serious cases our communities face, including murder, rape, armed robbery, large-scale drug trafficking, and crimes involving public corruption and ballot theft.
I've fought for crime victims every single day, and I was honored to receive the Champion for Crime Victims Award from the Crime Victims Foundation and I earned the trust of my fellow prosecutors to serve as President of the Prosecuting Attorneys Association of Michigan.
I have also worked to fix major problems across the state, not just in my home county of Eaton. I served on the Organized Retail Crime Advisory Board, the State Drug Treatment Court Advisory Committee, and as Chair of the Prosecuting Attorneys Association's Corrections Committee because keeping our communities safe has always been my priority.
And when the legislature changed the law to allow violent killers to be reviewed for parole every year, I worked with lawmakers on both sides of the aisle in Lansing to reform the law and extend the yearly parole review to a review every five years.
Most importantly, my record shows that I have never put politics ahead of the safety of the people I'm sworn to protect.
Over 60 prosecutors, sheriffs, and law enforcement leaders from across Michigan have endorsed my campaign because they know my record and they know my passion for holding criminals accountable.
I have never met someone who says that about Eli Savit. Since he wants to talk about things he's done that I haven't, allow me to add a few more items to that list.
Unlike my opponent, I've never let a convicted murderer out on bond, only to have that person murder two more people.I also have never supported letting a violent offender who strangled and beat a woman get only probation just for the criminal to be arrested again for shooting and carjacking a mother in front of her young child.
I've also not made it easier for criminals to roam our streets by eliminating cash bail and I haven't legalized prostitution and psychedelic drugs.
Eli Savit is such a dangerous candidate for Attorney General that his nomination has divided his political party. In an interview with a Detroit news station this week, his opponent in the Attorney General primary [refused to say whether she could support his candidacy](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Ni5vWPhPnk78VComjZS20VY9DxAU-mAzydY63UiC-tHfyu2vvOTARuq8P2GIBWk7OvwDTvX7QKGojL7WmmJE9zz78Y6lFxFPhrgsHhvC_AtAFGVsiT8Ypgm-eMGCllSqEvuoMZPwuSJ3s8fU2J702P5nqsAkPRf2VSHALPiOBeW0TuKebgDx41WKVJkYmKbgkV5QHdXCYslDSawM_G6E_SZ3Z-nNS-nDBlmH2QBaMuYoaOvvh268PeiVmQv-BnTro7GFs_HtUa_Ssg9Dls5vyA==&c=pmdPJFRDV43i_2Q6unYB9TYUEa3CxEI9KjFNO-bi4-IMy5M4uh4Ctg==&ch=qBWgLDznkZgdelBAedeD0B2kWFavWQhQNsojorLKMYn967VA6LyIrg==) or not. She went further to say the convention he was nominated at was full of hate and extremism.
This campaign for Attorney General comes down to a choice between the law and extremism.
If you want an AG that will put protecting Michiganders ahead of politics, stand with victims instead of criminals, and enforce the law fairly and equally for everyone, I am your candidate.
If you would like to hear more about me, why I am running, and my priorities for the Attorney General's office, I encourage you to watch CBS News Detroit in the 4:00 p.m. hour when I participate in a live interview for their news broadcast.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecutor Republican Nominee for Attorney General

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1933, Keystone Camp in Brevard held the first recognized [Christmas in July](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OhCAYQE-DnQaBESwotrGbbbc0_HzqN0EwgGO8_WbnCnuB917ez3N-GgwY12-zg65LmiNcJUCtkOfL5As9xHKlHLw7Dwu1YlztzCgbWipbJmZvMNyzaLxeABjwBnQvlVBKDrJvNm29sovkvRutpWbkivayd1yNwhvjH7xB_UejkomeUinGDpyTg1QWlOQPqxYiKHisKXevhLFusIQ7vSF3Lu1N0FutRyH8i7CJsOn05q4pduBPwiYb0loIm3aT0cSANpt8EzYxyvin_9G6LWOpuyktxvZ1hrs7tqPJ2h8XhoBlkETQdTcYPr76r0lvzX4DAAD__xLKe-M) celebration. The two-day event, organized at the request of co-founder Fannie Holt, inspired a tradition that later spread nationwide. Two women [smashed three world records](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OgzAUhE8DHZFtjP0oXGyTLttuifzzCC9rbGScoNx-Ra6w5Wik0Xzfz226WYqU7t92RVPnPCU89oi1YpkOWw4KmPYjlxj8c3NYK6W7mwQTqmO6E3IKluJ7km0wM6LAvkXDNUgArTRvFwOOj3zQwcLgg_JjH5jQiGNQ6NSItiVzrjEtJGdMy_GC3mulwSHofnAwN5JhoJrL5ZEp1QXn-M4vLBef1zaapdZtb_qvRlwbcbXbCXBWZyiVfMRGXONzdVge1v92H5jOL3bdKKd9oW3vjrxi6mQYLWoYuZyZwOCAK-G4cjD0DMDZtpiwHRQj7Uo3kt1XS_Hzov5L3cuIvwAAAP__VIKDUw) at the Lumberjack World Championships this week, as we report in _Et Cetera_ , and it got us thinking: what old-school skills are you still holding onto? Can you chop wood, change a tire, fix a leaky faucet without calling somebody? Hit reply and tell us the one skill you're proud you never lost. name: Internal Team
subject: 11 Days to Go to Primary- Let's Get Out There for Kevin Fagan!
body:
Hi there,

11 days. I cannot believe we are here. This is the final push, and I am so
fired up!

We are trying to hit 10,000 doors knocked before August 4th, and we need
everyone to show up however they can. Door knocking, phone banking, text
banking, even just 30 minutes, it all adds up, and it all matters. If the
heat or distance is a barrier for you, phone and text banking are just as
impactful, and you can do it from home. Just reach out, and I will get you
set up!

This weekend is a good one:

- *Today, July 24th, 2pm to 4pm* at Comstock Park
- *Today, July 24th, 5pm to 7pm* at Emma Rue's!! Grab a huckleberry mule
(proceeds go to Kevin's campaign). Kevin will be there, so it is a great
chance to meet him, hang with other volunteers, and get plugged in if you
have not yet. Voter registration on site too, so bring friends who are
not registered!
- *Saturday, July 25th, 10am to 2pm* at Hamblen Elementary School
- *Sunday, July 26th, 10am to 2pm* at Chief Garry Park with
Councilmember Sarah Dixit!!

Also, please please join our Slack if you have not already. That is where
everything happens: events, updates, coordination, all of it. I am on there
all the time, and it is the easiest way to stay in the loop and reach me.
Link below!

Join our Slack!!
<http://join.slack.com/t/kevinforcongressgroup/shared_invite/zt-41awqi9a8-YUXby_uhQWTV5PXhAHrHng>

You can also always text or call me at 509-481-7471 or just reply here.
Whatever works.

Thank you for being part of this & for caring about our future. Let's go
get it!!

Best,
*Sara Lambdin*
Volunteer Coordinator | 509-481-7471
*Kevin Fagan for Congress — WA-5*
KevinFaganForCongress <http://KevinFaganForCongress.com> |
@kevinfaganforcongress <https://www.instagram.com/kevinfaganforcongress/>
*Building the future we deserve in the Inland Northwest · *
*Primary: August 4, 2026*

Your Support Can Make a Difference - Help Houston Win This November!
| | | | A Note From Speaker Mike Johnson
---
| | | |
---
This is Speaker Mike Johnson, and I'm writing to thank you for your support of my friend Houston Gaines, and ask that you continue to support him. Houston won his primary and will be an outstanding new member of Congress representing your community.

But for him to be successful, we can't be complacent. We need to ensure he wins this general election.

Our majority in the U.S. House is already too tight, and I'm focused on helping some of our most competitive candidates around the country. That's why I'm asking you to help Houston get across the finish line.

Houston exhausted much of his campaign resources during a competitive primary, and now needs help rebuilding his war chest for November. [I'm asking you to consider chipping in whatever amount you're comfortable with--whether that's $50, $500, or $5,000.](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001HG8o81nq2g2G9su8F5mqu2-8RXgGtDekX2l0K_A1RUY1JdVyszKRn4ohFme98vZ_SWlzZGxoj-3Mgp7N0E9AKzHTv8lbGauk8zkdGgLbSKwFAB1Vkt4kNEiercJwP7eN6oZigIwBh9eIfI74PNDMWeqpPmwcpMhzXRNfUqwaFbJYYQdAZNY-73SfIFkezP26&c=JGtjhHLFhuCtIWlCzDFA8B0pVHB5zMWozaud9EmGgEw3MUHIn7XIEA==&ch=xvXH7l5_fyJTUieOXPQF8jrEA-vL-3bV0GKoQY7_4SXfB4baAbIgTw==)

Mike Johnson

name: Dan Cox
subject: Exclusive Report: Just Back from the RGA
body:
Watch my video report from meeting with our nation's top governors. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/coxforcongress/exclusive-report-just-back-from-the-rga?e=5bb5efcda7)
---
| |
# Our nation's best governors: "You can win this, Dan. Go for it! Beat Wes Moore for us all."
Dear friend,
Valerie and I just returned yesterday from three days of meetings with our nation's top 30 or so Republican Governors and former governors and their First Ladies and they gave us a lot of encouragement for our State and race. Watch my video update on the meetings, including with the governors of swing states, [here](https://us.list-manage.com/19zPi8mW3wR?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

In my meetings, including with GOP governors of blue states, one theme was common: Wes Moore's policies are some of the worst in the nation, making Maryland unaffordable for so many, and that with sufficient support, "you can win this, Dan."

**But it takes money.**

Right now, we need to pay for our planned:
* [$6000](https://us.list-manage.com/6RHzlKHc_Jy?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) postcard purchase
* [$12,000](https://us.list-manage.com/YNyTbBllgnE?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) next TV ad blitz
* [$500](https://us.list-manage.com/lQSl8CkQcHa?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)/week for social media
* [$7,500](https://us.list-manage.com/1C1qm5jkMJk?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) for more large signs
* [$9,000](https://us.list-manage.com/nHGqKJ_b6XN?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) billboard campaign

**Will you help us pay for these campaign strategies today? Each person can donate a maximum per election cycle of $6000 and a business can donate up to $6000 as well.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/zVkbrBwZQF7?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

The governors want us and Maryland voters to know that although it may appear Maryland is "blue," so were a lot of states that now sit with Republican governors**. It is common sense to give the People's money back to them through tax and fee relief, to empower them to become owners and innovators, to bring accountability to our state budget, and to ensure our kids have a safe and prosperous, well-rounded and educated future. And I believe we must back our law enforcement and the need to remove all dangerous criminals from our streets, not just those over 18 years old as Wes Moore has signed into law (SB 353, enacted/signed May 26, 2026).

So even though Wes Moore and company are raising money for his campaign in order to continue to take away your family's future with MOORE taxes, costs and LESS safety and opportunity, _we can beat him soundly if we raise the funds needed to get our message out_.

This is why every dollar counts - whether you can donate [$5, $10, $50 or $100 ](https://us.list-manage.com/1CI3O_qeIre?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)\- each donation helps us purchase the needed air time or materials to win for all of us.

Thank you and God bless you and our beautiful and great State of Maryland.

For Maryland,
[](https://us.list-manage.com/D03Xe8PuTbC?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
Dan Cox, GOP Nominee for Governor of Maryland

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

body:
A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck the Texas Panhandle at 5:21 a.m. Thursday. It was the [strongest recorded in the region](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2S4yAQBeDToAwXQkhIAcEmyrzphqoG2hLlRngB-ef2U3Ywc4DJu_q97_07L2cIFPb1L0Q09XlJy46PQlgr5uUG-wa7J0TIdft_wBXt4RDLIoUcuNBcqsVDoNeiGm-s8FPboGn1qMZJTGpqNiN66bvRoZOjQGudbzvV9aqzrZuE1roJ5v1MaKnaVkipT6IVWg29tzj0FmBkSqAPNeVT3bDiE8qFXumO-eRSbMhstd4K6_4wOTM5g3UaIuRAlN4HTM5vEZMzJQfE5Bxh3UM9PPKe_8B42eCKhX8C-Lec7wiZxwAx8KPwFROlNTggXo58xxc_ylqabPztEYhCGTRTYo0Q6NOu_m7Tu5FfAQAA___-dI6B) since at least 1900, according to U.S. Geological Survey records.

# Friday, July 24, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1969, _Apollo 11_ splashed down in the Pacific, and celebratory cigars were lit in Houston's Mission Control. The astronauts and the [first Moon rocks](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGypCAQgOHTYIaFLeIYEGxiNptuaLXSKrUMuNCO4-233rvCu8D_V31_ntMTffBx-40vsvxZ0xTpKoGYKU8Hxh2jC0SYef934l-az4WoTKDASNVL0JNDH-5JV87Oyg1NRbbpH_oxqEEP1W67Hk0L87oO66CdXmZo0RhnFu1m07Vd5e1XTPWgm0YB9LVqVK9N52Yy3Yz4EFqR85xyzTsxfbCs4U5vyvWSXlWwO_NRRPtLwChgvK6rjliw3tJbwLj7winfAsZOyZswF4lbknikEJJsGpmJzxyL5CT3dBZOUcBYZeuOy4fgi-mFVtsLffje8c-Q3hb-BwAA__8-OnxC) soon came home to Houston's Lunar Receiving Laboratory. Yesterday, we asked about your most memorable concert experience, and we were overwhelmed by the number and variety of the responses. Readers named venues from all over Texas (and beyond), dating back to the Beatles, Elvis, James Brown, John Denver, and Johnny Cash. Most mentioned concerts from the 70s and 80s, including Willie, Waylon, George Strait, The Eagles, Journey, The Moody Blues, Neil Diamond, Def Leppard, and the Rolling Stones. A reader named Mike remembers taking his high school girlfriend to see Henry Mancini and Sergio Mendes at the Texas Tech Coliseum in 1968. Mike married that girl, and they've been together 56 years now.
* * *

## Data Center Withdraws after Abbott Standards
Kansas-based Diode Ventures has [withdrawn its proposal](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u4yAQBeCnwR0RHhP_FBTbuLvbbmkNZmzQJeCFSZy8_cr7Crc70pE-HZ0_X8sXhhjS_hsfZPi95SXRWSMxU1kOTB6Ti0RY2P994jfZ50pUF1DQSzVI0IvDED-Lbpyxyk1tQ6YdRj1OatJT4802bb3eNCq6w9i6bkTrdD9Nne1guINugrkwNYBuWwUw3FSrBt3fnaX-bhFHoRW5wLnc2BPTG-sWP_lF5bbmRxONZz6q6H4JmAXM53neviO_rlLAfNkCZjVcuRMw7_kl0drMLCsGJ9f8ODB9pAtOlrB7luxD2uUZ2LuCJ0bpKTkqNSe55mfij3TIKFdKTEUeJR-5YhQwN8W44wwxhtoPQqv9gSH-H8k_u_Zl4F8AAAD__y2bjqg) for a data center near Cedar Creek Lake in Henderson County after failing to meet Gov. Greg Abbott's standards for new data centers. The company [told county officials](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGnMVvQcRgMg4dKFVu6dkTn-ACrDnZthyRvXyWv0Om_fPoN3_d5PpPzbl-_6Mq6PJYw73zPnkvhNEfaN9qtZ6ZUtt8b_bC5XZjzjID9CdQJ5WzJ-ecsK6sN2LGpWDdqkMMIoxyrTcPSMhujDAzcKsVyGfu2a3G8dGR77iqnXxgolE0DiKqGBpTsO2u47wzRICSwdSWkumxc-EF58c9wcKov4Vp5vZUSs2g_BE4CpzUc9XtUr-EQON2iD2SzwGlxnl-NifOrny5YrqNdqqRtvDvvXe6VkLBeyfk3Xv53yaHxLwAA___C1HXV) Wednesday that the site's proximity to the lake's rural residential community "does not meet the higher standard" it believes should guide development. | Friday, July 24, 2026| Oil Tops $100 As Iran War Widens
---|---
5-minute read · 4 stories
Lead Story · The WarOIL BLOWS PAST $100 AS RED SEA ATTACKS WIDEN THE IRAN WARWhat's Happening
* Brent crude closed up about **7% at $100.69 a barrel** Thursday, trading as high as roughly $102 during the day; U.S. crude rose 6.2% to $92.19, its highest close since June 4.
* The jump followed claims by Iran-backed Houthi rebels that they had attacked **two Saudi oil tankers** in the Red Sea and announced a naval blockade of the kingdom.
* Oil is now up roughly 35% since the start of the month and more than 60% since the start of the year.

The Situation
* Roughly 12% to 15% of global maritime trade — worth more than $1 trillion a year — passes through the Bab el-Mandeb strait near the attacks.
* The U.S. has carried out nearly two straight weeks of nightly airstrikes on Iran; President Trump said Washington will hold Tehran responsible for Houthi attacks and warned of “major military punishment.”
* Trump has signaled he is not ready to negotiate a new ceasefire, while Iran’s leadership has vowed to keep threatening the Strait of Hormuz. The tanker-strike and casualty claims come from the parties to the conflict and have not been independently verified.

The PerspectivePeace comes through strength, but strength has a price tag, and right now Americans are paying it at the pump. A conflict half a world away is bleeding into every gas station and grocery bill at home, which is the clearest possible argument for the thing Washington keeps deferring: unleashing American energy production so that a Houthi speedboat in the Red Sea can’t hold our economy hostage. Backing our allies and answering attacks is right and necessary, but the surest way to blunt Tehran’s leverage is to make our own supply so abundant that their threats stop moving the market.[Read the full story at NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_KnXUR8YWdaXuMqU6tjDoFWLhViJbji3LORZxsS6Sy65IKtiAdf5zYLe2PDT33SYuvVSw9NECJI6_KmiNMJOuWzHGABzNDWpJTVTsZX5OhqhwrVLQqibA70iW1Z2HC_5kHQzwzOxzur91H1ze9h4iv4NXafv-SoDgDH8-ys8DJt13JK7yQtN__WicpLMnkRxsM3Cbiv9CdKP63YMh6d0IrN5soN4hQQQVNZo-TtI9BkpWtQJIqZWdhf3noQiY3JpYWdbRwcCs-H_o62p2wPdC0bdACcCXQ0lQh0hJQ1TZhdCHvqN8TSzSCgDGcG0JB6K3rQ25Y2-lP_NP6FvnH-ylUqrmFZ80lU5Gw1Keb8o9p-S/4sl/cTRz5s7bQtOZ0CNImOQrHw/h5/h001.d06Gi99Z1UchnxZD_rdQmgdfRykNk8zvA4fTSbTncNM)

War FundingHOUSE PASSES $1.14 TRILLION DEFENSE BILL — AND RENAMES THE PENTAGONWhat's Happening
* The House passed the fiscal 2027 National Defense Authorization Act on Wednesday, **216-212** , authorizing roughly $1.14 trillion in defense spending.
* The bill includes **5% to 7% pay raises** for service members and new money for missile defense, hypersonics, munitions and autonomous systems.
* A provision renames the Department of Defense the **Department of War** , and Republicans attached the SAVE America Act — a voter ID and proof-of-citizenship measure — to the bill on its way to the Senate.

The Situation
* Normally bipartisan, the NDAA drew opposition from 205 Democrats and seven Republicans; only six Democrats crossed over to support it.
* GOP holdouts included Reps. Thomas Massie, Chip Roy, Anna Paulina Luna, Tim Burchett and Eli Crane. Massie objected to a provision deepening U.S.-Israel defense-technology integration.
* The SAVE America Act attachment is designed to pressure a Senate that has stalled on the voter-integrity measure for months.

The PerspectiveA well-funded, well-paid military and a serious push on election integrity are exactly what conservatives have asked for, and both are in this bill. Renaming the Pentagon the Department of War is more than symbolism — it’s a reminder of what the institution is actually for. In fairness, the Republicans who voted no aren’t squishes: Massie and Chip Roy have real concerns about the price tag and about entangling our defense industrial base with a foreign partner, and those are debates worth having out loud rather than papering over. A trillion dollars deserves scrutiny even from the people who support spending it.[Read the full story at Washington Examiner](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_F0KAElx4yVoiF03sTMUTyWGzC9AGAjyTA5yLjEEj0SGjDgTMoXRQ-fi115woR0iGQ4A5coJ8WuMB1jnvFh3tGzMtbFLJZ55fQkyhfw4gAzErjCI3n-VhHbNqY3nerO3NLD4EEaOWuCQay8cbowjFC_2Sh5cHOqjhM1b_ZOfKcP4Je4W9dpmLlBtLrDrv7kdexQ-ibHxsLGuBm1R9LGhZ3gesQfbetNf0id-GjxVkZrL7pdsSsLgltgH4EZ8E5zatze4rFHuh6_M58_86LY7EjdU7oGGxyzu2UntWJm9JqIMXUA85g_y9fJRFrnckkyp66IyMKYPl6kaWi5JVgpaPhxatzONcI9YZ45_gw68x8M1/4sl/cTRz5s7bQtOZ0CNImOQrHw/h6/h001.cnbYtqr4LffWbykvG3pN4h85GgACLsxTMpTV3Xnm7lc)

TradeTRUMP HITS 60 COUNTRIES WITH NEW FORCED-LABOR TARIFFSWhat's Happening
* The administration is rolling out new **Section 301 tariffs on 60 countries** , taking effect Friday at 12:01 a.m. ET as an earlier stopgap 10% tariff expires.
* Rates split into two tiers: **12.5%** for countries with no forced-labor import laws and **10%** for those deemed to be enforcing such laws inadequately.
* Officials say the new duties **will not stack** on existing tariffs — steel and aluminum stay at 50%, not higher.

The Situation
* In February the Supreme Court struck down Trump’s “Liberation Day” tariffs imposed under emergency-powers law; Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 is the new legal footing.
* Affected partners reportedly include Canada, Mexico, India and the U.K. at 10%, with Taiwan and the European Union at 12.5%. The E.U. rejected the forced-labor accusation, and critics call the move a workaround of the court ruling.
* U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told lawmakers, “The specific authorities this administration is using have changed, but the trade strategy has not.”

The PerspectiveAnchoring these tariffs to forced labor is smart politics and defensible policy — almost no one wants American shelves stocked with goods made by slaves, and using every lawful tool to reshore industry is a promise this administration ran on and is keeping. Conservatives should still be honest with themselves: tariffs are taxes, and someone pays them, often American importers and consumers. The right test isn’t the press release but the result — whether this actually brings production home and gets our trading partners to clean up their supply chains, or just nudges prices up while the courts take another look.[Read the full story at Washington Examiner](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_F0KAElx4yVoiF03sTMUTyUT70T3bUtUddhBUBTd1H3EfqhMMfoe01oFxlPezjHk2L6R8K07_OwCHty1458-Itij-sOB7OjFFL1VzsZwkjE-cHIIBdWarG0mUCsAKi6rZd-_MdGNaAGh0zofl6hqiGa4efcpW-J-e5d5rMr0-C2qFJhLv9xnjJK3L2omxfsXxOVtRcmk3zaYl9oWQRX4qkWZrlJJFlKWQ-bvmN9xv1_z83Hie_AGc-wT0ic_l49WpaT4vlaAb9VIjft4QEbIPnu1UdZ782YAk76WBRei7FoVvSzlOhzhCcuJ13EJ9DZ9didXkfkYd0HmB4JlKwAn_syODgp89jrtUPUTeQVDI0eL2GY88KYgFCBzxRhEWtp37NhKKn5WG4hKudKl6H3PRmU/4sl/cTRz5s7bQtOZ0CNImOQrHw/h7/h001.RcenLzz3_5XhQekr-q0bk8zwRcBQ7cxtLHWVneHk4yI)

Press FreedomDOJ WITHDRAWS SUBPOENAS AGAINST NEW YORK TIMES REPORTERSWhat's Happening
* The Justice Department agreed Thursday to **withdraw grand jury subpoenas** seeking testimony and phone records from four New York Times reporters and family members.
* The reporters — Tyler Pager, Julian Barnes, Eric Schmitt and Eric Lipton — had bylined a story on the president’s Air Force One travel.
* The reversal came after a federal judge sharply questioned the subpoenas in court.

The Situation
* The leak probe stemmed from reporting that Trump flew home from a NATO summit in Turkey on his older Air Force One rather than the new Qatar-gifted Boeing 747-8, citing security concerns amid the Iran escalation.
* U.S. District Judge Arun Subramanian cited “profound First Amendment issues,” saying subpoenas to reporters “are not the first thing you do; they are the last thing you do.”
* Times counsel David McGraw called the decision “an important affirmation of our country’s commitment to a free press.”

The PerspectiveGive credit where it’s due: backing off these subpoenas was the right call. Conservatives who spent years warning about a weaponized Justice Department can’t cheer press-freedom protections only when the reporters are friendly. Government has a legitimate interest in plugging genuine national-security leaks, especially about the president’s movements during a shooting war — but dragging journalists and their families before a grand jury is a last resort, not an opening move, and the judge was right to say so. | ⚡ The Bottom LineA war abroad is showing up in the price of your gas, Congress is funding that fight while pushing election integrity, the trade fight found a new legal lane, and even a hostile newsroom got its First Amendment day in court — a reminder that strength and restraint aren’t opposites, and that the principles conservatives claim only count when they hold for everyone. Take action and contact your elected officials | | | We haven't been emailing a whole lot lately, but this is important. There is a [National Campaign ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.SNYHID0cgDJeR88MOfSMufL_c1HuForccWHCYGJQiZiiTGi7p3zqJBShl6-I97-QTL09Yrd16lmVA_zsnCNDuhPhKLi7SjTzyg5pDhKO1ONZfeclepwfinmW14R_4pgrqCGBzOiVT34aWqhgVRb6iqG2F8HtZ0u45gMyBy-hRWSCNN3KecxPanl5D7UqnczAvt2Qg8gocLmerwA6IU08G2mfgkEteIptMdlejhId8F_eXxrR1Yi7yRHXw1wPnvhGbnYJRwTG2d_DWUx2NKpgYw/4sl/2L-dTNtbRWq8HHQVRWdoGg/h0/h001.xRg0QRaDFQxtxiPhwvYjYYkDENuegU3g2srrAREDiHY)happening and we are at the front of this fight here in PA. name: Melanie Lucero For Congress
subject: Today is the last day
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MELANIE LUCERO FOR CONGRESS
body:
Most people only change after the heart attack. Virginia can't afford that. Today's the last day.
| [ MELANIE LUCERO
FOR CONGRESS · VIRGINIA'S 5TH DISTRICT ](https://us.list-manage.com/17Qw2Nz_B6n?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
Deadline day · July 24
# Don't wait for the heart attack.
Peter,Here's a hard truth about human nature: most people don't make a change until it's almost too late to matter. We change our diet _after_ the heart attack — not before it, when it could have saved us.I don't want that to be the story of the Republican Party. Look at the direction Virginia has taken. And do you know one of the biggest reasons why? Record-low Republican turnout. We didn't lose this state because the other side won the argument. We lost it because too many of us stayed home and assumed someone else would carry the fight.But here's the good news: it's not too late. This is the _before_ the heart attack — the moment you can still do something about it. And today is the day it counts:**Today, Friday, July 24, is the last day** to register to vote or update your address, and the last day to apply for a mail-in ballot for the August 4 Republican primary.If you've moved, if your son or daughter just turned 18, if you're not 100% sure your registration is current — take 60 seconds right now and check. Not tonight. Now.Don't think others will take up the fight for you. That thinking is exactly how we got here. **VOTE.** | [Check My Registration Now](https://us.list-manage.com/T_61p5VKykm?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---

* * *
For the 5th,
Melanie Lucero
Marine Veteran · Republican for Congress, VA-05
**P.S.** Already squared away? Forward this to one person who's moved in the last two years — that's the person this deadline catches.

name: Dr. Vanessa Enoch
subject: I'm asking for your help!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,
I want to take a moment to thank everyone who has supported this campaign so far. Whether you've shared a post, attended an event, made a donation, or simply encouraged me along the way, you've helped us build something special.
Over the last several weeks, we've been all over Ohio's 8th Congressional District. We've been knocking on doors, talking with voters at community events, making phone calls, and listening to people who feel like Washington has forgotten them. Everywhere I go, I hear the same thing: people are ready for leadership that listens, shows up, and puts people before politics.
Those conversations remind me why I'm running.
But I'll be honest with you—campaigns like ours don't run on big corporate checks. They run because ordinary people decide they're going to be part of the solution.
That's why I'm asking for your help today.
If you can spare a few hours, we'd love to have you on our volunteer team. Whether you're comfortable knocking doors, making phone calls, helping at an event, or pitching in behind the scenes, there's a place for you.
**Sign up to volunteer here:**
[ https://campaignhq.app](https://us.list-manage.com/412HpKrlcGc?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
If volunteering isn't possible right now, would you consider making a contribution?Every dollar helps us print literature, purchase yard signs, fuel our travel across the district, reach more voters, and keep building the grassroots campaign we need to win.
**Chip in today:**
[https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now](https://us.list-manage.com/16dqbPwj70G?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
This campaign belongs to all of us. Every conversation we have, every door we knock, every volunteer who joins us, and every donation—large or small—brings us one step closer to the kind of representation our communities deserve.
I'm grateful to have you on this journey with me, and I hope you'll continue walking beside us in these final months.
Let's keep showing up. Let's keep organizing. And let's win this—together.
With gratitude,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Candidate for Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District
**P.S.** If you've been waiting for the right time to get involved, this is it. We have the momentum, but we need more hands, more hearts, and more voices to reach every voter before Election Day. I hope you'll join us.

Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer.

# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=7910%2E582294%2ElPNhsn)
Team, it’s Chris.
We’re reaching a breaking point.
While national Republicans are dumping over $25 million into New Hampshire to flip this Senate seat red, my campaign is making crucial spending decisions.
**[If that’s all you have time for, can I count on you to chip in $5 immediately to help our campaign fight back against the MAGA money machine? »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260724_1.RGkG9p&refcode=em20260724-1&t=2&akid=7910%2E582294%2ElPNhsn)**

The GOP knows this race could decide control of the Senate, so they're flooding the airwaves in an attempt to bury our message and buy this election outright.
When we built our campaign plan, we budgeted for a competitive race. But we didn't anticipate this level of outside spending this early.
Now we're facing a critical fundraising gap: If we can't make up ground, we'll have to make difficult cuts to our budget – scaling back advertising, delaying investments in voter outreach, and slowing down the organizing program we're building across New Hampshire.
National Republicans are counting on our grassroots campaign to fail – but with your support today, we can close this gap and prove them wrong.

| | | | | |
Dear Friends,I wanted you to be among the first to hear the news—I am excited to announce that I’m running for Daly City Council!This campaign is built on one simple principle: local government should provide **opportunity for all.** Today, families across our city are feeling the squeeze of rising housing, healthcare, and grocery costs. Young families wonder if they can afford to stay, and seniors worry about being priced out. Working people deserve a City Hall focused on making life more affordable while protecting the unique quality of life that makes Daly City so special.As a lifelong resident and the proud son of working-class Filipino immigrants, these challenges are personal. My family has called Daly City home since 1977, when my parents bought our home at the Top of the Hill. I attended our local schools and learned the values of hard work, service, and looking out for your neighbors.My career has been dedicated to serving this community. For the past ten years, I’ve served as Chief of Staff to San Mateo County Supervisor David J. Canepa. As Vice Chair of Daly City's Personnel Board, I’ve also gained firsthand experience in making local government more responsive and accountable. I know how to navigate government, build partnerships, and bring resources home because I’ve spent my career doing exactly that.If elected, I will focus on delivering real results that provides opportunity for all:
* **Affordability:** Improving housing affordability, expanding healthcare access, and helping families keep up with the cost of living.
* **Public Safety & Infrastructure:** Investing in first responders, fixing flooding challenges, repairing potholes, and strengthening transit options.
* **Family Support:** Advocating for a childcare center at Daly City Hall to support working parents and make city services more accessible.
* **Senior Care:** Protecting and expanding programs that help seniors age safely and independently in their homes.

**I’m ready to step into a leadership role myself in every way but I can’t do it without you. As I know from helping to run Supervisor Canepa’s campaigns and you probably do too, campaigns are not cheap.**[**Can you be one of my founding donors?**](https://us.list-manage.com/P45K1gf7rhA?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)**Nothing is more important to a campaign than early money, as it helps us get off to a fast start and build a winning campaign from the get-go.**
[**Could you donate today in any amount up to $5,900? $1,000, $500, $100 or even $25 will make a huge difference to my campaign at this early stage.**](https://us.list-manage.com/jUvhI1QX1rW?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)
Our city has always been defined by hardworking families, diverse neighborhoods, and neighbors who care about one another. Together, we can build a Daly City that is more affordable, safer, better prepared for the future, and continues to be a place where families of every generation can thrive – a Daly City that truly provides opportunity for all.I would be honored to earn your support, your ideas, and your vote.In friendship,
Tony BayudanCandidate for Daly City Council**P.S. Anything you can donate today at**[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tony-bayudan-1**](https://us.list-manage.com/19Zslo2pIkP?e=a77f0ac4a9&c2id=f2f0b537fa844d5b5a30cd2c82e303f0)**will be so valuable – even if it’s just $5!**

| | "I was not raised in a religious family. I was wandering. It was a Moms for America Cottage Meeting series one year ago that set me on my trajectory to Christianity. I didn't have God and now I do, and now my son has the benefit of that." She was wandering. No community. No foundation to stand on. And life is hard enough without trying to do it alone. Then she walked into a Cottage Meeting and found a room full of moms who didn't judge where she'd been. They just welcomed her in. That one meeting became a turning point. She found faith. She found community. And now her son is growing up in a home that looks completely different than the one she grew up in. Future generations of her family will never be the same because one mom walked through one door. That Cottage Meeting was free. The resources on Moms Town Square are free. The community is free. They're free because people like you make them possible. Your monthly gift is the reason the next mom who's wandering can walk through that door and find what she's looking for. It's the reason the next family gets a new trajectory. I'm inviting you to join the 1776 Club with a monthly gift of $17.76. That's less than $20 a month to help the next mom find her community, her courage, and her voice. And when enough moms find their voice, a nation can change. When I decided to run for Congress, it wasn’t because I’m a politician — because I’m not.

I’m a nurse practitioner who's spent years sitting with patients in their hardest moments. A mom who worries about the world her kids will inherit. A veteran who believes that service doesn't end when you take off the uniform.

I look at what’s happening in Ohio — families struggling to afford groceries, childcare costs through the roof, a congressman who's spent decades in Washington playing political games while the people he’s supposed to serve fell further behind.

Mike Turner is still in Washington after 23 years. He has the support of special interests and the GOP establishment behind him. And now he knows we're coming.

We’re in the general election, and our mission is clear: flip OH-10 from red to blue, take back the House majority, and show Washington that working families won't be ignored anymore.

**I’ve never walked away from a hard mission. Not in uniform. Not in scrubs. Not as a mom. And not now.**

Peter, Donald Trump’s allies clearly want to intimidate voters out of participating in this year’s elections — including threats to deploy ICE agents at polling places. Now Trump’s Department of Justice (DOJ) is also trying to intimidate _the top elections officials_ in every state. The DOJ sent letters threatening criminal prosecution if they allow noncitizens to vote (a MAGA obsession entirely rooted in fiction). When Utah’s Republican Lieutenant Governor got the message, she called it “truly bizarre behavior.” Let’s be clear: Noncitizen voting is already a crime — and more importantly, it just doesn’t happen to any serious extent. Even the right-wing Heritage Foundation has only flagged a grand total of 99 possible examples since 2000. But that's not the point: Trump's allies want to harass the officials who oversee our elections in their relentless effort to suppress the vote and silence communities of color. [**We are fighting back for elections where every American has an equal chance to make their voice heard. By fanning the flames of conspiracy theories around alleged noncitizen voting, Trump’s DOJ is sowing doubt about the integrity of future election results.
They’re laying the groundwork to say that Democratic victories aren’t legitimate because of false claims of ineligible voters casting ballots. Republican extremists would have you believe that they only lose elections if other people cheat.
Really, they’re telling on themselves — they’re the ones who’ve been racing to cheat in the 2026 midterms with a national gerrymandering frenzy and brazen attempts at voter suppression. All because they’re afraid to face the voters in free and fair elections.
**From manipulating maps to attacking access to the ballot to trying to intimidate voters, and now trying to intimidate top elections officials, MAGA’s attacks on democracy have escalated to an unprecedented scale in recent months. We need to respond with an unprecedented defense of democracy.**

clean_body: Anti-democracy moves like these call for a full-throated response | Peter, Donald Trump’s allies clearly want to intimidate voters out of participating in this year’s elections — including threats to deploy ICE agents at polling places. Now Trump’s Department of Justice (DOJ) is also trying to intimidate the top elections officials in every state. The DOJ sent letters threatening criminal prosecution if they allow noncitizens to vote (a MAGA obsession entirely rooted in fiction). When Utah’s Republican Lieutenant Governor got the message, she called it “truly bizarre behavior.” Let’s be clear: Noncitizen voting is already a crime — and more importantly, it just doesn’t happen to any serious extent. Even the right-wing Heritage Foundation has only flagged a grand total of 99 possible examples since 2000. But that's not the point: Trump's allies want to harass the officials who oversee our elections in their relentless effort to suppress the vote and silence communities of color. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = By fanning the flames of conspiracy theories around alleged noncitizen voting, Trump’s DOJ is sowing doubt about the integrity of future election results. They’re laying the groundwork to say that Democratic victories aren’t legitimate because of false claims of ineligible voters casting ballots. Republican extremists would have you believe that they only lose elections if other people cheat. Really, they’re telling on themselves — they’re the ones who’ve been racing to cheat in the 2026 midterms with a national gerrymandering frenzy and brazen attempts at voter suppression. All because they’re afraid to face the voters in free and fair elections. From manipulating maps to attacking access to the ballot to trying to intimidate voters, and now trying to intimidate top elections officials, MAGA’s attacks on democracy have escalated to an unprecedented scale in recent months.
