body:
My team and I are sitting down right now to make tough calls about this campaign that could decide whether we win or lose.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106509?refcode=em20260724-10697&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10697%2E614464%2EFBtyxI)
Hi, it’s Dan Osborn, the Independent candidate running to defeat Republican Billionaire Pete Ricketts for U.S. Senate in Nebraska.
I’m going to level with you.
My team and I are sitting down right now to make tough calls about this campaign that could decide whether we win or lose.
→ How many people can we afford to put on the ground?
→ How many doors can we knock?
→ How loud can we make our message when we’re up against someone with unlimited money?
Because here’s what I’m up against: **_My opponent is a billionaire. I’m not._**
I don’t have a pile of cash to fall back on. I don’t have corporate PACs waiting in line to bail me out. What I’ve got is a campaign built the hard way — by regular people chipping in what they can.
**_And right now, we’ve got gaps to close. If we don’t start raising more money, we’ll have to make tough decisions about which outreach programs to keep and which to cut._**
**So I’m asking straight up:[Can you pitch in $10 or whatever you can right now to Heartland Patriots and my campaign so we can keep building this campaign?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106509?refcode=em20260724-10697&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10697%2E614464%2EFBtyxI)**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106509?refcode=em20260724-10697&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=10697%2E614464%2EFBtyxI)**
Every dollar we raise goes directly into reaching more people — more conversations, more momentum, more chances to prove that this race doesn’t belong to the highest bidder.
I won’t pretend this part is fun. Asking for money never is.
But I believe in what we’re building here. And I believe that if enough regular folks step up, we can beat someone who thinks this seat can be bought.
**So I’ll ask one more time:[Will you chip in today to me and Heartland Patriots to help us close the gap and keep this campaign moving?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106509?refcode=em20260724-10697&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=10697%2E614464%2EFBtyxI)**

This only works if we all show up.
— Dan Osborn

name: DiLorenzo for Congress
subject: “Anthony DiLorenzo will deliver the representation New Hampshire deserves.”
body:
On Thursday, WMUR joined Anthony as he met with voters at the Red Arrow Diner in Manchester to discuss key endorsements and his plan to lower costs..

| | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

_Peter_ ,On Thursday, [WMUR joined Anthony at the Red Arrow Diner in Manchester](https://us.list-manage.com/gL1zChpcOMG?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c), where he spoke directly with voters about the challenges facing working families and his plan to lower costs, create opportunity, and bring greater prosperity to New Hampshire.With the support of [President Trump](https://us.list-manage.com/E7AOu3szW_n?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c), the entire [House Republican leadership team](https://us.list-manage.com/D6sTvO_9lFV?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c), [Congressman Jim Jordan](https://us.list-manage.com/1Cz_phLRwjm?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c), and [Turning Point Action](https://us.list-manage.com/AOLjCiDKfaK?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c), our campaign continues to build momentum. But Anthony has always said that the endorsement that matters most is the support of Granite Staters.Across New Hampshire, business owners, community leaders, elected officials, and working families are rallying behind Anthony because they know Washington needs common sense, accountability, and proven leadership.**Hear why Granite Staters are supporting Anthony:**
---
|
---
| |

[**Congressman Frank Guinta**](https://us.list-manage.com/62lftskSbDE?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) _Former Mayor of Manchester and New Hampshire’s last Republican congressman_ “I am proud to endorse Anthony DiLorenzo. As the former Mayor of Manchester and New Hampshire’s last Republican Congressman, I know what it takes to represent Granite Staters. It requires common-sense leadership, a willingness to make tough decisions, and a relentless focus on delivering results.Anthony has spent his career building businesses, creating jobs, and solving real problems. He understands the challenges families and small businesses face because he’s lived them. I’m confident Anthony will bring that same practical, results-driven approach to Washington and be the strong voice New Hampshire deserves.”
---
|
---
| |

[**Russell Prescott**](https://us.list-manage.com/TXDLVdGtmQo?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) _Former Executive Councilor and Republican nominee_ “I am proud to endorse Anthony DiLorenzo. Anthony has the experience, grassroots support, and capabilities necessary to win in November.As a self-made businessman, he knows what it takes to lower costs, build housing, create jobs, and improve the lives of all Granite Staters. It is time for New Hampshire to have the representation it deserves in Washington.”
---
|
---
| |

[**State Representative Joe Alexander**](https://us.list-manage.com/B9uGpIJLnvg?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) “As chairman of the Housing Committee, I see firsthand how rising costs are hurting working families. Granite Staters deserve common-sense representation that will fight to build housing, lower energy costs, create safe communities, and promote responsible government.Anthony DiLorenzo understands these challenges and has the real-world experience to deliver results for New Hampshire.”

---
|
---
| |

[**State Senator Howard Pearl**](https://us.list-manage.com/1BeKzwSpkgE?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) “As a lifelong Loudon resident, sixth-generation farmer, and small-business owner, I know firsthand the challenges facing New Hampshire families and businesses.Our federal delegation has failed to deliver the common-sense leadership Granite Staters deserve. Anthony DiLorenzo will change that. In Congress, Anthony will fight to lower energy costs, stand with law enforcement, support our local communities, and deliver real results for New Hampshire.”
---
|
---
| |

[**Brittany Ping**](https://us.list-manage.com/12rCKBQxkLl?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) _Small-business owner and community advocate_ “As a mother, a small-business owner, and community advocate, I have felt firsthand how our current federal representatives have failed our state.It is time New Hampshire had common-sense representation in Washington that is willing to fight for Granite Staters and deliver results. Anthony DiLorenzo will do just that. In Congress, Anthony will fight to lower energy costs, back law enforcement, support our communities, and deliver results for Granite Staters.”
---
|
---
| |

[**Steve Stepanek**](https://us.list-manage.com/EWDQKoU4J3Q?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) _Former Chairman of the New Hampshire Republican Party_ “It’s time for New Hampshire Republicans to rally around Anthony DiLorenzo. Anthony is a world-class businessman, a pragmatic leader, and a proud Granite Stater.At a time when our state is represented in Washington by out-of-touch Democrats, Anthony is a breath of fresh air. I encourage all my fellow New Hampshire Republicans to join me in supporting him and help elect a member of Congress who puts Granite Staters first.”
---
|
---
| |

[**State Representative Tanya Donnelly**](https://us.list-manage.com/KcFnyFXzaBu?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) “Anthony DiLorenzo sees opportunities where our current federal representation falls short. With the proven ability to create and sustain businesses through all economic conditions, he has helped create jobs for thousands.Anthony’s vision goes beyond being a businessman. He recognizes how government inefficiencies can lead to delays and missed opportunities for New Hampshire. I am proud to support him because he will fight for our families, small businesses, and the New Hampshire way of life.”
---
|
---
| |

[**State Senator Daryl Abbas**](https://us.list-manage.com/18bFJ2dTdsj?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) “Anthony DiLorenzo is exactly the kind of leader New Hampshire needs in Congress. He’s not a career politician—he’s a businessman who knows that results matter more than rhetoric.While Washington talks, Anthony acts. His resolve and commitment to New Hampshire values are why I’m proud to endorse him for Congress.”
---
|
---
| |

[**State Senator Tim Lang**](https://us.list-manage.com/19DOs6sO1vo?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) “Anthony understands that opportunity does not come from government. It comes from hard work.He’s done the hard work, lived the American Dream, and is running to make sure it still exists in New Hampshire.”
---
|
---
| |

[**Chris Bright**](https://us.list-manage.com/Rc7UtRrCv98?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c) “I’m proud to endorse Anthony DiLorenzo because he lives the values that make New Hampshire exceptional: hard work, responsibility, and freedom.Anthony is a proven problem-solver who will fight for our families, support small businesses, rein in spending, and protect the American Dream for every Granite Stater.”
---
|
---
| |
**Next Upcoming Events:**
---
| |

[ July 29th: Seacoast Cars and Coffee Candidate Conversation](https://us.list-manage.com/eZtSHf4MrJw?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c)[July 31st: Manchester Meet and Greet](https://us.list-manage.com/lfS25MrgxtY?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c)[August 4th: Thomas Laighton Cruise](https://us.list-manage.com/nPb5D8uiwzX?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c)
---
|
---
| |

Anthony is not running because he needs a job. He is running because Washington is not working for the people, and New Hampshire deserves a representative who knows how to solve problems, create jobs, control spending, and deliver results.**Together, we can bring common sense and accountability back to Washington.**[[WATCH THE WMUR STORY]](https://us.list-manage.com/13hIV5YugnB?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c)[[JOIN TEAM DILORENZO]](https://us.list-manage.com/CIpXwIfa9ZH?e=ea055ff6e2&c2id=138bb2a294361e102508eb24ce83203c)Thank you,**Team DiLorenzo**

Peter, voters are furious, and they have every right to be.

Families are paying too much for groceries, housing, healthcare, and gas. And instead of doing anything to make people’s lives better, Republicans are using their House majority to rig the system so fewer people can hold them accountable at the ballot box.

The SAVE Act would impose sweeping new requirements on Americans registering to vote, forcing people to produce specific documents proving their citizenship.

But millions of U.S. citizens don’t have ready access to a passport, birth certificate, or other qualifying documentation. And voters whose current names don’t match the names on those documents — including many married women and members of the LGBTQ+ community — could face even more paperwork and bureaucratic hurdles to exercise their right to vote.

**This law will prevent millions of eligible Americans from making their voices heard._And that’s the goal._**

Voter suppression isn’t an unintended consequence. It is part of a deliberate MAGA Republican strategy to cling to power by making voting harder.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. As an instructor in Georgia State’s nursing school, I’ve spent years teaching and supporting the students who keep our healthcare system alive. I know how hard they work, how much they sacrifice, and how urgently our state needs more advanced practice nurses — not fewer.
So when I saw this headline...
https://secure.ngpvan.com/4OI02pK92kOTd_uWTjBgFg2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4OI02pK92kOTd_uWTjBgFg2]
...I felt sick.
Under Donald Trump’s new proposal, advanced nursing degrees would no longer count as “professional,” meaning students would lose access to the federal loans they need to pursue graduate education. Loan limits would be slashed in half. Thousands of future nurse practitioners, nurse midwives, CRNAs, and clinical nurse specialists could be forced to take on massive private debt — or give up their dreams entirely.
This is not just bad policy.
It’s dangerous — for patients, for hospitals, and for the future of healthcare in this country.
Georgia already faces provider shortages. Rural communities already wait weeks for care. And now Trump wants to create even fewer advanced practice nurses?
We cannot allow this to go unanswered.
The American Nurses Association has already sounded the alarm, and more than 200,000 nurses and patients have raised their voices. Now I’m asking you to add yours:
Will you sign the petition demanding the Department of Education reverse this reckless decision and recognize advanced nursing degrees as the professional degrees they are? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4OI02pK92kOTd_uWTjBgFg2]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4OI02pK92kOTd_uWTjBgFg2]
Our nurses deserve respect. Our students deserve opportunity. And our healthcare system deserves investment — not sabotage.
Thank you for standing up for science, for students, and for the people who keep us healthy.
Dr. Jasmine Clark

| Letter from the Chair
---
This is the fight for Nebraska. Show up.
The Democrat Socialists of America (DSA) has laid out its platform in black and white, and it should shock every Nebraskan who cares about this state. Abolish ICE. Strip away police immunity. End the "U.S. war machine" aka our military. Lift sanctions on hostile regimes. A Green New Deal that would gut our energy and ag economy, plus "economic democracy" that hands government and union bosses control over Nebraska businesses. This isn't some far-off national fight, it's the agenda DSA-aligned candidates are quietly running on right here, from school boards to Congress.
What does "Democracy" mean to DSA? The US is founded upon a Constitutional Republic form of government and not a democracy for a reason. Democracies result in tyranny of the majority and no consideration of the minority. A Constitutional Republic has checks and balances to prevent both tyranny of the majority and tyranny of the minority.
And ask them directly, they'll point to Norway, Sweden, and Denmark as the model.
What they won't tell you is the bill: Sweden's top tax rate hits roughly 52%, starting around $58,000 a year, not just on millionaires. Denmark's is nearly 56% and heading past 60% in 2026. All of them charge a 25% national sales tax on almost everything you buy. Total tax collection there runs 40-45% of the economy, nearly double the U.S. rate. That's the real cost of "free" everything, and it lands on the middle class, not the activists writing the platform.
Read more about the DSA platform below or click here: [https://program.dsausa.org/](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001igQfhMpq2s0NBguxk3VqpuCmxYl4Z1ahy92e1egyWqz7kkcd12YWQUBpD2riD-mvAK3HFg5TfWlGohoJn-EOmmO-SB6M68ee8G0XaJjoNQy8wG4jL6lKUMDkdbkSiNAccp4BRmdLtusCLrEOT2r-k_oSZtVRbW19&c=ZRF_S_hBcBwneubV2JenE0aVMwMYCcZCoiIDBwDIWvBPP1P0nvq4Mw==&ch=gXXScgWaTTDZbF2uLCufhrEf_meYhQ318LyXyOLukX1asy7UE3os0Q==)

| Nebraska values mean backing the badge, a strong national defense, and an economy built on energy, agriculture, and hard work -- not one strangled by socialist mandates and European-style taxation dressed up as "reform." Every plank of this platform asks Nebraskans to trade what built this state for a program that taxes working families harder to pay for it. Saving Nebraska doesn't happen by accident -- it happens because Republicans out-organize, out-work, and out-vote the other side, election after election. That starts now.
Make your plan to vote today. Your silence implies consent to this radical agenda. The General Election is November 3, 2026. Mail ballot applications for the general election open July 6, early voting starts October 5, and registration closes October 16 -- don't let the deadline find you unprepared. Go to vote.ne.gop right now: verify your registration, request your mail ballot, or find your polling location in under three minutes.
Then don't stop there. Talk to your neighbors. Bring three people with you when you vote. This is not a spectator fight, and Nebraska is not up for grabs. Make your plan. Vote Republican. Save Nebraska.
Together, We Win!
In Liberty and in Truth,
Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Your broker is probably lying to you. # **NYPD furious as Mamdani urges Netanyahu protests at UN General Assembly**
NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani is **[calling on New Yorkers to protest Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's anticipated visit](https://substack.com/redirect/a363796f-8160-4d30-9926-acd396d99897?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for September's UN General Assembly, after backing away from his campaign pledge to have Netanyahu arrested under an International Criminal Court warrant. NYPD union leaders are furious, warning the mayor's rhetoric will embolden violent agitators and create dangerous conditions for officers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a363796f-8160-4d30-9926-acd396d99897?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **NYPD Police Benevolent Association President Patrick Hendry said Mamdani 's "activist posturing" puts officers in an impossible position,** noting the department's protest response is already constrained by a prior lawsuit settlement. Rank-and-file officers who just completed grueling 12-hour shifts covering the World Cup, Knicks championship, and America 250 celebrations expressed disbelief that their own mayor is now adding to their burden.
* **Despite the frustration, NYPD union officials pledged the department would handle whatever demonstrations arise** with full professionalism. Mamdani's office did not respond to requests for comment.

Ilhan Omar's sister Sahra Noor incorporated her consulting firm Grit Partners at a Lakeville, Minnesota address connected to at least three convicted participants in the Feeding Our Future scandal, one of the largest fraud cases in Minnesota history.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a42941aa-ef8c-4a67-af33-a4e3424de099?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **The address is reportedly tied to Ister Ahmed Afraa,** who had business connections to both a woman convicted of $7 million in wire fraud and Aimee Bock, the Feeding Our Future ringleader sentenced to 41 years in prison.

* **Noor previously ran a Minneapolis health clinic that received a $2 million state earmark arranged by Omar** while she was a state representative. Noor's husband later worked as chief of staff to Somalia's prime minister and policy advisor to its president after relocating to Africa.
* **Democrats blocked a legislative subpoena in May** that would have required Omar to produce records related to the fraud investigation.

# **Obama Presidential Library contractor struggles after not being paid nearly $4 million owed**
Chicago-based Adamson Plumbing Contractors **[suspended operations and laid off 25 union workers](https://substack.com/redirect/ba3f4cd5-b27b-46bc-9cd5-207ae8e25d66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the owner says the company was left with roughly $3.9 million in losses from delays, rework, and unpaid change orders on the Obama Presidential Center project.
* **Owner Mike Owen says a promised $100,000 payment that was supposed to arrive before the center 's June 19 opening never came** on time, becoming what he called "the final death blow" to the company. Adamson has since filed a $1.72 million mechanic's lien against the property and is pursuing additional legal action. Owen says the delayed payment eventually arrived, more than two weeks after he suspended operations, but came too late to reverse the shutdown.
* **Several other subcontractors, including Black-owned firms** the project was specifically intended to support, have reported similar payment disputes.
* **The Obama Foundation said construction manager Lakeside Alliance was responsible for subcontractor payments.** Construction costs have reportedly surpassed $1 billion, while only $1 million of a promised $470 million taxpayer protection reserve has been funded.

# **Hot mic catches Sacramento officials discussing how to ban disruptive protesters**
A live **[microphone caught](https://substack.com/redirect/2eb19733-e30e-4150-aa84-12155839af9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Sacramento Mayor Kevin McCarty and Vice Mayor Karina Talamantes discussing whether they could bar disruptive attendees from future city council meetings, with McCarty saying the city attorney had advised against it. The exchange occurred after council chambers were cleared Tuesday following repeated disruptions during a heated debate over the city's participation in a regional intelligence-sharing center linked to federal immigration authorities.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/589d0973-6c10-4905-82d8-ad60254cbee7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **The meeting descended into chaos** after Talamantes defended accepting federal funding for the Central California Intelligence Center, arguing Sacramento's sanctuary city protections made it better positioned to oversee the grant than other jurisdictions.
* **Protesters accused the council of enabling information sharing with ICE,** a charge police officials denied, saying Sacramento complies with California's sanctuary law and does not share personal data for civil immigration enforcement.
* **Critics accused Talamantes** of attempting to silence vocal opposition.

You don't have to be an economist to see that working people are struggling in an economy that isn't working for them. Across Iowa, families are doing everything right and still finding it harder and harder to make ends meet. **Instead of fighting to lower costs, politicians like Mariannette Miller-Meeks continue to side with the powerful interests driving them up.**

Health insurance premiums and prescription drug prices continue to climb, and the cost of groceries and other everyday necessities keeps rising.

Opponents of voting rights are trying everything they can think of to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address Trump's often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. Vice President J.D. Vance called on Congress again recently, begging them to pass this awful bill ahead of the next election.
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now, Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=072426_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. Hey there, Today, I need to ask you to make a donation to my campaign in NY-17 before our next big fundraising deadline. This is one of just three districts that split their ticket for Kamala Harris and a Republican in 2024 – we cannot afford to leave winnable districts like this on the table. But Mike Lawler is going to put up a fight. He’s got millions of dollars in the bank, the Republican establishment has signaled that they’re willing to airdrop more cash to help, and Donald Trump has personally come to town to campaign for him. body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135911891/635740665/-1060083271?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MzVmYjAyMy03NDg3LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YEL8JbF2S_LJ6HQ6W4xgCOqnNqZ1qwUogWkTeeLHsH4=)
Peter, With so much going on every day in Washington, where I’m fighting to put money back in your pocket and protect critical local and regional jobs, you can miss the small things from back home. For me, I’m truly grateful for any opportunity to be back in Illinois and able to make a home-cooked meal. And if I could, I’d be like every other Midwesterner in the summer and grill every night. Because nothing quite says summer like bratwursts! So in that spirit, I wanted to take a minute and share my go-to recipe: **Summer Brats with Drunken Onions**
* 2-3 Onions
* 2-3 Tbsp of Butter
* 4-6 Bratwursts Sausages
* 1 can of light beer
* 2-3 Tbsp of Stone-Ground Mustard

**Directions:**
1. Start by putting two or three onions in a saucepan with 2-3 tablespoons of butter. Saute until translucent.

2. Add uncooked bratwurst to the saucepan and cook, lightly browning the edges of the sausage.

3. Add one can of light beer to the pan. Put a lid on the pan and simmer. The longer you simmer, the more flavor!

4. Take brats out of the pan and onto a plate. This is a good time for the brats to be finished on a medium-hot grill. _(Just to brown them.)_

5. In the pan with the drunken onions, simmer until most of the moisture is gone. Then, add a healthy two or three tablespoons of stone-ground mustard to the pan...stirring to incorporate.

6. Serve brats on brioche buns with the onion-mustard sauce on top. Enjoy! _(And any leftover brats should be refrigerated in the onions. They became friends in the saucepan... might as well let them hang out in the fridge.)_

I hope you take the chance to try this out, and let me know how it goes! clean_body: | = Peter, With so much going on every day in Washington, where I’m fighting to put money back in your pocket and protect critical local and regional jobs, you can miss the small things from back home. For me, I’m truly grateful for any opportunity to be back in Illinois and able to make a home-cooked meal. And if I could, I’d be like every other Midwesterner in the summer and grill every night. Because nothing quite says summer like bratwursts! So in that spirit, I wanted to take a minute and share my go-to recipe: Summer Brats with Drunken Onions 2-3 Onions 2-3 Tbsp of Butter 4-6 Bratwursts Sausages 1 can of light beer 2-3 Tbsp of Stone-Ground Mustard Directions:** 1. Start by putting two or three onions in a saucepan with 2-3 tablespoons of butter. Saute until translucent. 2. Add uncooked bratwurst to the saucepan and cook, lightly browning the edges of the sausage. 3. Add one can of light beer to the pan. Put a lid on the pan and simmer. The longer you simmer, the more flavor! 4. Take brats out of the pan and onto a plate. This is a good time for the brats to be finished on a medium-hot grill. (Just to brown them.) 5. In the pan with the drunken onions, simmer until most of the moisture is gone. Then, add a healthy two or three tablespoons of stone-ground mustard to the pan...stirring to incorporate. 6. Serve brats on brioche buns with the onion-mustard sauce on top. Enjoy! (And any leftover brats should be refrigerated in the onions. They became friends in the saucepan... might as well let them hang out in the fridge.) I hope you take the chance to try this out, and let me know how it goes! Enjoy! -Eric | = | Eric Sorensen is a meteorologist born and raised in Rockford, IL representing IL-17 in Congress. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
LAST CALL: Sign the pledge to support a brighter future for working Texans
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
These last few weeks, TOP has teamed up with our friends at the Organizing Revival Network to promote the Willing to Fight Pledge [https://toptx.us/orn] -- a commitment to a vision and future where ALL Texans have the ability to grow and thrive.
We're only a few days from our end-of-June deadline. Can you sign the pledge today to help us reach our completed pledge goal? [https://toptx.us/orn]
It only takes a minute and your feedback provides our groups with a look at what issues matter most to you and your family.
👉🏾 Take the pledge now! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Celebrating our communities and building fellowship this Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%202026%20Juneteenth.jpg]
TOP staff and members celebrated Juneteenth alongside community partners at events across Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio this past week. Through that celebration we honor the ancestors we stand on the shoulders of, and recommit to working tirelessly toward a future where race and class are no longer barriers to justice and opportunity in our country.
Juneteenth serves as a renewed call to unite against racial and economic injustice, so that we can chart a path toward a stronger Texas and nation that uplifts and empowers every Black person, regardless of their background or economic status. This is why we organize. This is why we are stronger together.
Taking time this summer to refuel for the second half of 2026
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20summer%202026%20out.jpg]
TOP offices will be closed Saturday, June 27 - Sunday, July 5, as we take time to rest, rejuvenate, and prepare for a busy rest of 2026 filled with organizing and getting out the vote! You can still keep in touch with us online, though. Give us a follow on the following platforms:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/texasorganizingproject/]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/texasorganizingproject]
BlackTOP Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/TXOrgProject]
Bluesky [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
TOP Tip: Get the most out of your vacation phone pics
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Summer%202026%20vacation%20photo%20tips.jpg]
Taking quality phone pics can be easier said than done! Whether you're traveling abroad, across the state, or just within your community this summer, utilize these easy tips [https://www.techadvisor.com/article/3170604/8-professional-tips-for-better-smartphone-photos.html] on how to get the most out of your smartphone photos this summer to capture those special moments.
https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/_ew4evGgs0i4Ml7-RjD4tQ2]
Español
ÚLTIMA OPORTUNIDAD: Firma el compromiso para apoyar un futuro mejor para los trabajadores de Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
En las últimas semanas, TOP se ha unido a nuestros amigos de Organizing Revival Network para promover el compromiso "Willing to Fight" [https://toptx.us/orn] (Dispuestos a Luchar): un compromiso con una visión y un futuro en los que TODOS los tejanos tengan la oportunidad de crecer y prosperar.
Estamos a pocos días de nuestra fecha límite de finales de junio. ¿Podrías firmar el compromiso hoy mismo para ayudarnos a alcanzar nuestra meta? [https://toptx.us/orn]
Solo te llevará un minuto, y tu opinión nos permitirá saber qué temas son los más importantes para ti y tu familia.
👉🏾 ¡Firma el compromiso ahora! [https://toptx.us/orn]
Celebrando a nuestras comunidades y fortaleciendo la camaradería en este Juneteenth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%202026%20Juneteenth.jpg]
La semana pasada, el personal y los miembros de TOP celebraron Juneteenth junto a aliados comunitarios en eventos realizados en Houston, Dallas y San Antonio. A través de esta celebración, honramos a los ancestros sobre cuyos hombros nos apoyamos y reafirmamos nuestro compromiso de trabajar incansablemente por un futuro en el que la raza y la clase social ya no sean barreras para la justicia y las oportunidades en nuestro país.
Juneteenth representa un llamado renovado a unirnos contra la injusticia racial y económica, para así trazar el camino hacia un Texas y una nación más fuertes que impulsen y empoderen a cada persona afrodescendiente, independientemente de sus antecedentes o situación económica. Por esto nos organizamos. Por esto somos más fuertes unidos.
Dedicar tiempo este verano a recargar energías para la segunda mitad de 2026
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Spanish%20summer%202026%20out.jpg]
Las oficinas de TOP permanecerán cerradas desde el sábado 27 de junio hasta el domingo 5 de julio ; aprovecharemos este tiempo para descansar, renovar energías y prepararnos para el resto del año 2026, ¡lleno de actividades de organización y movilización del voto! Sin embargo, pueden seguir en contacto con nosotros a través de internet. Sígannos en las siguientes plataformas:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/texasorganizingproject/]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/texasorganizingproject]
BlackTOP Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Summer%202026%20vacation%20photo%20tips.jpg]
¡Tomar fotos de calidad con el teléfono móvil es más fácil de decir que de hacer! body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=2712%2E251025%2Ezo7gVC ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=2712%2E251025%2Ezo7gVC ]Abdul for US Senate

Recently, a Jan 6 terrorist, Jake Lang, tried to crash one of our canvass
launches:

[ Jake ]Jake Lang [ A ]A GIF of Abdul and the room full of people chanting 'USA!'
to get Jake Lang to leave

He stood up and started shouting, and then we chanted him out of the room,
shouting “USA! USA! USA!” over his ramblings.

The reason I wanted to clap him out to “USA” is because he doesn't hate me
or you,
Peter —
he hates America.

He hates the idea of what America was always supposed to be: of the
people, by the people, for the people. An America where it shouldn't
matter the color of your skin, how you pray, or who you love.

And every day we go out there and knock on doors, we make an argument
about what America actually is.

An America that's bigger than his hate and small-mindedness.

An America that's bigger than MAGA Mike Rogers and the corporate
corruption they all take to run these campaigns and pick our pockets.

That's the America this Jan 6 terrorist is so mad he didn't get. As ugly
as his display was, our movement is a beautiful display of the America we
can still build.

Peter,
In just a second, I am going to ask you to [**chip in $5 to my must-win U.S. Senate race in Georgia.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260724-1-f&utm_campaign=em260724-1-f&t=2&akid=2573%2E5691347%2Eh1EOO3)
But first, I want to tell you about my decision to run for Senate back in 2020, and what that race tells us about our path to victory in the midterms.
Long before I ran for office, I was an investigative journalist. My team investigated and exposed sexual slavery by ISIS, crooked judges, contract killers, human traffickers, war crimes, and bribery.
So when I decided to run for Senate, it was with the goal of mounting a ruthless assault on corruption in our political system — corruption we see everywhere from exorbitant drug prices to insider trading in Congress.
I knew that if we were going to win, it would take a grassroots army unlike anything Georgia had ever seen before to unseat an entrenched Republican incumbent.
With your help, we shocked the nation and we WON, alongside Rev. Warnock, to secure the Senate majority in 2021.
**Now we have to do it again, in what I expect will be the closest Senate election in the country and the most expensive campaign of the midterms.**
Donald Trump and MAGA know their policies are unpopular with Georgians and they’re terrified to lose the midterms. So he will reheat debunked election conspiracy theories and tell bizarre new lies to deny his 2020 defeat and attack voting rights.
My team and I are fighting back against these attacks and redoubling our voter protection efforts all across the state. **But we can’t do it alone.**
**So I’m humbly asking concerned citizens nationwide to join me and give $5 — or any amount — to help my campaign do this important work and win here in Georgia.**

# Iran
* **U.S. continues strikes on Iran as renewed assault enters second week:**
* Four people were killed and five others were wounded in overnight U.S. strikes on areas around the southwestern city of Ahvaz in Khuzestan province, according to Al Jazeera.
* The death toll in Iran from U.S. airstrikes since July 6 has risen to 59 people killed, including three children, and 666 wounded, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/7d1b516b-fbec-4d73-8bed-43e2dbfdea62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Iran's Health Ministry.
* U.S. Central Command [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/671a6e5e-97a6-400a-b715-e208fd6f887a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its 13th night of strikes on Iran continued on Iranian military sites, and that its ongoing naval blockade on Iran had redirected 12 commercial vessels and disabled one.
* U.S. strikes hit at least six provinces early Friday, local time, with missiles reported in the cities of Ahvaz and Omidiyeh in Khuzestan, on the southern coast of Qeshm island, in the port city of Bandar Abbas (where at least two were reported injured and power was temporarily cut off), and in Khorramabad in the Lorestan province. Multiple sites in the Yazd and Markazi provinces were reportedly struck as well.
* Iranian authorities reported Thursday that U.S. strikes hit an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps naval command headquarters in the northern province of Gilan. The facility in the Zibakenar area was struck in the morning, damaging some equipment inside the complex, according to Iran's Islamic Republic News Agency.
* **Iran conducts retaliatory strikes:**
* The Iranian Army [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/d3cc955e-a7b6-4b74-9972-1c620a7b8a22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) attacks against U.S. military installations in Jordan, Bahrain, and Kuwait, including Kuwait's Camp Behring base, on Thursday evening.
* An Iranian missile reportedly struck Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan, where U.S. forces are stationed, according to initial reports cited by Tasnim.
* Iran's IRGC [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/fc21077b-8ca1-4c04-afc9-4970773b2d7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that it struck Ali Al-Salem Air Base in Kuwait on Thursday with a wave of heavy drone attacks, destroying a large ammunition depot and multiple troop housing structures.
* Missile defenses and air sirens in Kuwait were [activated](https://substack.com/redirect/1e906f17-51df-44bc-8594-1ba709946bdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday evening and Friday morning as a result of Iranian missile strikes, according to the country's army.
* Multiple explosions were also [heard](https://substack.com/redirect/8dbc546c-5a96-4343-afd0-3649c43b2a30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Friday morning near Erbil airport, in Iraqi Kurdistan, a site of multiple Iranian attacks.
* **Wounded U.S. soldiers transferred to Germany:** About 10 U.S. service members seriously [wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/b07f6101-ab34-4777-ae5e-df23fa221fff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in recent Iranian attacks have been transferred to a U.S. military hospital in Germany, the New York Times reported on Thursday, citing a U.S. military official. The transfers indicate some injuries were more serious than earlier Pentagon descriptions, which said most involved minor traumatic brain injuries.

* **Trump says U.S. will use seized Iranian funds to pay for "damages": **President Trump [threatened](https://substack.com/redirect/93c808b2-3b65-456a-a418-0b321330f0c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday to use the Iranian money it has seized to pay for "any and all damages" to ships and cargo from this point forward. "These damages may be very substantial but, nevertheless, this is the fair and equitable thing to do," Trump said Thursday, without providing a legal justification for the move or citing the precise source of the funds.
* Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned in a [response](https://substack.com/redirect/c196e603-e180-4418-963a-e5435ff3038f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that confiscating another country's assets to pay for unrelated future claims would set an "incendiary precedent," adding that "Those who celebrate or profit from such funds should remember: once governments normalize confiscation, no one's assets are safe."

* **WSJ: Iran rebuilding faster than Israeli intelligence expected:** Iran has quickly rebuilt infrastructure [damaged](https://substack.com/redirect/d6b71bd6-da21-4883-b14f-a6a26988f6ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) during months of U.S. and Israeli bombing, from missile bases deep inside mountains to bridges, ports, and production facilities, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
* Planet Labs and Airbus imagery showed repairs at missile bases near Kangavar, north of Kermanshah, and at Dezful, where crews reopened collapsed tunnel entrances and repaved access roads within weeks.
* One Israeli military official said Iran repaired a bridge hit by three Israeli bombs within days. Officials also said that some strikes only collapsed entrances to deeply buried facilities, leaving the missiles inside intact.

* **Tanker traffic through Hormuz slows** : Tanker traffic [carrying](https://substack.com/redirect/39af600b-45d1-4f89-8e82-2670c5686cce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) oil and other products eastward through the Strait of Hormuz has slowed to a trickle, according to Kpler data, with just 10 recorded transits from July 17-23, including zero on July 22.
* Those tankers carried a combined 15.7 million barrels over seven days, averaging just 2.24 million barrels per day.
* **Two tankers reportedly leaking oil in Strait:** Two tankers are [leaking](https://substack.com/redirect/0ff334c7-a741-4a12-948f-a9f597165706?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) oil near Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, with slicks drifting toward Larak and the Qeshm coastline, according to maritime intelligence firm Windward.
* Satellite and radar imagery from July 21-23 identified one vessel as the Kavomaleas, which was struck in an earlier attack.
* Windward assessed that spill as fuel rather than cargo because the tanker was traveling in ballast.
* The second vessel is an unidentified "dark tanker" operating without AIS tracking. Windward said imagery places it in the same location since May.

# Palestine
* **Four Palestinians killed as Israel orders sweeping West Bank offensive:** Armed Israeli settlers, backed by Israeli forces, killed at least four Palestinians and wounded eight others during an attack on the town of Tal, southwest of Nablus on Friday. During the assault, a Palestinian man seized a settler's weapon and opened fire, killing two armed settlers and wounding two others.
* Tal Mayor Walid Zidan said around 20 settlers attacked the village between 7:30 and 8 a.m. before continuing their assault in the Qabala area. "Residents rushed to defend homeowners in the area," he said. Zidan said the Israeli military claimed that a Palestinian opened fire after taking a settler's weapon, "while other accounts indicate that Israeli forces opened fire at everyone present."
* A graphic [video](https://substack.com/redirect/a08e259d-f32f-4d46-8043-d6b41d5f1cf6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the subsequent killing shows settlers shooting Palestinians in a field.
* In retaliation for the settlers' death, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz [said](https://substack.com/redirect/5b770673-7bc3-459c-ac4c-33159d4f1a9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) they have launched a series of military operations including home demolitions, weapons raids, the revocation of work permits in villages Israel labels "terror hotspots," additional checkpoints and road segregation measures. "The security forces must be allowed to operate freely and with full force," the two officials said.
* National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir said Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank should be made to resemble Beit Hanoun, the Gaza town Israeli forces have razed to the ground, in retaliation for the attack.
* This follows Thursday's killings of four Palestinians by Israeli forces and settlers across the occupied West Bank: two were killed and four others wounded in Beit Furik, east of Nablus; a 25-year-old Palestinian from Tubas was shot dead by Israeli forces in Jenin; and another young Palestinian died after being shot and arrested by Israeli soldiers at a checkpoint in Shuafat refugee camp in occupied East Jerusalem.
* Settlers also escalated attacks on several neighboring Palestinian communities, subsequently attacking the village of Far'ata, east of Qalqilya, wounding seven Palestinians, according to the Palestinian Red Crescent.
* Israeli forces also raided Nablus Specialized Hospital and stormed the emergency department. Hospital officials said soldiers tied the hands of doctors and nurses and detained two brothers, including one who was being treated for a gunshot wound sustained during the attack on Tal.
* Yesh Din and more than a dozen other Israeli human rights groups urged immediate international intervention to prevent what they warned could become "mass pogroms" across the occupied West Bank.
* **Israel 's campaign of destruction in Gaza continues unabated:**
* Israeli forces [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/81a513c8-11b3-4dcb-a25f-41a30058f15d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) near Al-Yemen Al-Saeed--a hospital turned shelter in Jabliya refugee camp--killing two, including a child, and injuring others.
* Israeli warplanes destroyed the Al-Noor Mosque and structures surrounding it on Thursday, southeast of Bureij refugee camp, after residents were ordered to evacuate.
* Israeli forces [shelled](https://substack.com/redirect/53eaec82-498b-4ba0-8d58-bb81b4084559?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a tent sheltering displaced families south of Khan Younis, wounding several, including multiple children.
* An Israeli strike on Thursday [hit](https://substack.com/redirect/a39e80d7-33d5-488d-b0ec-e2bf1bec96d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a family home in Gaza City, wounding two people.
* An Israeli airstrike later on Thursday [hit](https://substack.com/redirect/0c68fa28-a7cb-43ce-8ee9-8676de76ed4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a residential apartment in Gaza City, killing a woman and wounding a man.
* Unexploded Israeli ordnance [detonated](https://substack.com/redirect/c237a6d1-b515-4133-a196-c70379734aa5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Khan Younis, wounding two Palestinian brothers, Gaza police reported on Thursday, with one of the boys requiring his hand to be amputated.
* **Chickenpox continues to spread in Gaza:** More than 53,000 chickenpox cases have been recorded since the start of the year, Gaza's Health Ministry [said](https://substack.com/redirect/09aee1d1-8646-4dbe-96d3-3b6eb5a773df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), warning that the surge is "record-breaking and alarming" and signals a dangerous loss of epidemic control.
* Severe overcrowding in displacement camps, shortages of clean water, collapsing sanitation, and the breakdown of primary health care due to Israeli attacks on hospitals and restrictions on the entry of medical supplies are accelerating transmission.

* **Gaza floods with wastewater:** A makeshift sewage pit [collapsed](https://substack.com/redirect/88604993-85a5-48d7-b24c-e1b4c8099e73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) inside a displacement camp in Gaza, flooding tents with wastewater, damaging families' belongings, and creating serious health risks, according to Gaza journalist Tamer Nahed.

* **Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian vineyard:** Israeli settlers [destroyed](https://substack.com/redirect/17fce2fc-6ee3-4f3b-b2e9-5b40de6c0a6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) roughly 4,000 kilograms of grapes in a vineyard belonging to the Al-Janazra family in the Wadi Qaboun area of Halhul, north of Hebron, days before the crop was due to be harvested, according to the Palestinian Information Center.
* The family had cultivated the 2.5-dunum plot for a full year. About 50 family members depend on it for income.
* Part of the land had already been cut in two by a settlement road, and the family maintains a near-constant presence there because of the nearby Israeli outpost and repeated threats.

* **Health condition of detained Gaza surgeon rapidly deteriorating:** Dr. Murad Al-Qouqa, 47, head of orthopedic and spine surgery at Al-Shifa Medical Complex, has lost roughly 45 kilograms and suffered a serious eye injury affecting his vision since Israeli forces seized him from the hospital, the Palestinian Center for the Defense of Prisoners [said](https://substack.com/redirect/2e514797-05e0-478e-9c1f-486f214a1f61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday.
* Israeli forces arrested Al-Qouqa on March 19, 2024, during their raid on Al-Shifa while he was treating the wounded. Several other medical staff were taken with him. Since then, the center said, he has been subjected to torture and physical and psychological abuse, was denied blood pressure medication, and has a herniated disc and stomach ulcers. He has been denied visits from his lawyers and the Red Cross.

* **Israel approves expanded settlements:** Israeli authorities have [approved](https://substack.com/redirect/193095a9-4d45-483e-8688-e8791398f3a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a settlement plan covering nearly 6,000 dunums (600 hectares) of Palestinian land east of Bethlehem, the Applied Research Institute-Jerusalem reported.
* ARIJ said the plan, approved by the Gush Etzion Regional Council, would expand the illegal Tekoa settlement southward between Tuqu' and Al-Minya.

* **Israeli banks cut off Palestinian lenders:** Israel Discount Bank [will](https://substack.com/redirect/ec1b982d-f339-4459-9465-516420aab1bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) end ties with Palestinian lenders on Sept. 1, and Bank Hapoalim will make a similar termination on Oct. 1, Reuters reported.
* Together, these banks process about $16.6 billion a year in Palestinian transactions. Palestinian banks now appear likely to be cut off from Israel's financial system, threatening imports, salaries, and government operation.

* **Moroccan officers make first field tour of Gaza ahead of force deployment:** Around 30 Moroccan military officers [entered](https://substack.com/redirect/f5ec36b8-1cbb-4516-ab5f-8b83feb1f5f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Gaza on Wednesday for what Israeli broadcaster Kan reported was the army's first field tour of areas where its troops are expected to operate, part of preparations for a multinational force proposed under Trump's "Board of Peace," The New Arab reported.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli drone wounds two paramedics in "double-tap" strike in south Lebanon: **Two paramedics were [wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/b4060b96-8e9e-4f3f-ad2d-a5b94b80cee6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and their ambulance damaged after an Israeli drone struck a Civil Defense vehicle at the site of an earlier attack in Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, southern Lebanon, on Thursday, according to the Islamic Health Authority.
* At least 130 paramedics have been killed and 260 emergency responders wounded in direct attacks since Israel's latest war on Lebanon began on March 2.
* Israeli forces also [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/572a3897-e744-465c-b74c-2dd0e1a930a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) several demolitions on road crossings linking the southern Lebanese towns of Hadatha, Tayri, and Kounine, according to Lebanon's National News Agency, despite the U.S.-brokered "ceasefire." Israeli troops conducted a large-scale demolition in the town of Khiam, the agency reported.
