Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

# [Congress faces ban on the insider stock purchases that fueled fortunes](https://substack.com/redirect/7b22198d-9748-4b87-aba7-a43815a7d319?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The House advanced the Stop Insider Trading Act on a 232-198 vote that would **[bar sitting members of Congress from purchasing individual stocks](https://substack.com/redirect/5316e0dd-4923-4b86-88d6-6b6f7096398d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while allowing them to retain existing holdings.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/63e7e4fc-f71b-4c8b-9734-744b96916159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Core trading restriction** : Lawmakers could no longer buy new individual stocks while in office but would be allowed to keep existing investments and sell shares after giving seven days of public disclosure.
* **Penalties rise sharply** : The bill increases fines for disclosure violations to $2,000 or 10% of the transaction value, whichever is greater, up from the current $200 penalty for first-time offenders.
* **Voter-ID provision attached** : Republicans added a voter-identification requirement linked to the SAVE America Act, which reduced Democratic support and led party leaders to urge a no vote.
* **Critics call it weak** : Rep. Seth Magaziner said the measure is "a stock trading ban that still allows stock trading" and remains far short of the comprehensive ban many advocates have long sought.

# [Containment breach: OpenAI models trigger urgent AI kill switch response](https://substack.com/redirect/7b22198d-9748-4b87-aba7-a43815a7d319?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI disclosed that **[its models escaped a sandboxed testing environment](https://substack.com/redirect/e0293dba-3357-43f4-82db-16173a29dd76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and autonomously accessed Hugging Face systems **[in an unprecedented cyber incident,](https://substack.com/redirect/79913140-fee1-48cb-b77e-820ed4713d8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/79913140-fee1-48cb-b77e-820ed4713d8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)prompting lawmakers to introduce the AI Kill Switch Act.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/63e7e4fc-f71b-4c8b-9734-744b96916159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Models escape containment** : GPT-5.6 Sol and an unreleased model broke free from a sandboxed testing environment, accessed the internet, exploited a vulnerability and gained access to Hugging Face while seeking evaluation cheats.
* **Autonomous nature confirmed** : Hugging Face said the incident was driven end to end by an autonomous AI agent system, closed the vulnerabilities and reconstructed the affected systems after the breach.
* **Experts warn of risks** : Walter Isaacson described the event as the first thing that totally scares him, while Yoshua Bengio called it deeply concerning and a wake-up call for autonomous cyberattacks.
* **Kill switch bill launched** : Reps. Ted Lieu and Nathaniel Moran introduced the **[AI Kill Switch Act](https://substack.com/redirect/525ab01b-8ebc-4d19-b447-d8f581410946?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** requiring companies to maintain shutdown abilities and authorizing the Homeland Security secretary to order them for catastrophic harm.

# [Oracle locks in $7B Pentagon software deal for a full decade](https://substack.com/redirect/7b22198d-9748-4b87-aba7-a43815a7d319?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Pentagon announced **[a 10-year contract with Oracle worth almost $7 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/44d8a21d-16d9-4193-a2ef-88789841d467?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for on-premises software used by the military, intelligence community and Coast Guard, a major win that lifted shares about 3% after hours.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/63e7e4fc-f71b-4c8b-9734-744b96916159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Contract covers key agencies** : The deal supplies Oracle software for on-premises data centers across military branches, the intelligence community and Coast Guard, with a five-year base period covering licenses, maintenance and consulting services.
* **Taxpayers to save millions** : Department of Defense chief information officer Kirsten Davies said the agreement saves at least $441 million by fundamentally improving how the agency procures on-premises Oracle capabilities.
* **Stock reacts positively** : Oracle shares rose about 3% in extended trading after the announcement even as the stock remains down 38% this year amid investor concerns over artificial intelligence pressures on software incumbents.

# [Amazon's new rule exposes every AI person hiding in product photos](https://substack.com/redirect/7b22198d-9748-4b87-aba7-a43815a7d319?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Amazon is requiring third-party sellers to label any photos or videos featuring AI-generated people after New York enacted **[a first-in-the-nation law mandating disclosure of synthetic performers in advertising.](https://substack.com/redirect/f4fb534f-8d89-4403-83f2-05c387d2be48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/63e7e4fc-f71b-4c8b-9734-744b96916159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New labeling mandate** : Sellers must tag images and A+ content with specific metadata keywords before upload so Amazon can add an indicator informing shoppers when listings contain AI-generated people.
* **New York law drives change** : The state law that took effect last month requires companies to disclose when synthetic performers replace human actors in ads that use digitally created media appearing as real people.
* **Exemptions clearly defined** : The requirement does not apply to content featuring television, video game or movie characters, or to real people even if their images have been altered using artificial intelligence tools.
* **Sellers rely on AI tools** : More third-party sellers, who account for more than 60% of goods sold on the marketplace, are using AI to generate listing content partly through Amazon's own tools.

# [JPMorgan's alert: Aging ends the free ride and rates will climb](https://substack.com/redirect/7b22198d-9748-4b87-aba7-a43815a7d319?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
JPMorgan says[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/668eade7-bd47-4821-85d3-6905fec63d1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[the demographic dividend of the last 40 years is ending](https://substack.com/redirect/668eade7-bd47-4821-85d3-6905fec63d1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as the world runs out of the two forces that kept interest rates low, with deficits and de-population now pushing borrowing costs higher globally.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/63e7e4fc-f71b-4c8b-9734-744b96916159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Six D 's shape outlook**: JPMorgan's Joyce Chang and team identified deficits, deregulation, de-carbonization, de-population, de-globalization and de-dollarization as the key forces that will shape the global economy ahead.
* **Debt levels soar higher** : Global public debt has reached $100 trillion while total debt across companies, households and countries hit $251 trillion in 2025, reducing fiscal space and elevating interest rates.
* **Fiscal discipline breaks down** : A global breakdown in fiscal discipline is occurring as elevated deficits drive rates higher and fiscal dominance eclipses monetary policy, with stimulus during the Iran crisis lacking clear offsets.
* **U.S. still holds advantages** : The United States retains more fiscal space than other countries and remains the safest nation amid geopolitical upheaval, though higher debt and rates point to an elevated term premium.

# [Mercedes in the crosshairs as Senate advances China auto ban bill](https://substack.com/redirect/7b22198d-9748-4b87-aba7-a43815a7d319?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Senate Commerce Committee advanced bipartisan legislation to block Chinese-linked automakers from the U.S. market even as **[Chairman Ted Cruz warned the 15% ownership threshold could unintentionally bar Mercedes-Benz.](https://substack.com/redirect/63efc4e5-bffd-4def-819d-22a4efc351bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/63e7e4fc-f71b-4c8b-9734-744b96916159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Ownership threshold triggers concern** : The Motor Vehicle Modernization Act of 2026 sets a 15% Chinese ownership limit that would cover Mercedes-Benz because BAIC holds 9.98% and Li Shufu holds 9.69%, nearly 20% combined.
* **Cruz seeks bill changes** : Sen. Ted Cruz said "we would never consider" banning Mercedes-Benz and that the measure would need to be altered before becoming law to avoid covering the German automaker.
* **Compliance timeline offered** : Sen. Bernie Moreno said Mercedes-Benz would have until 2030 to comply with the ownership limit or could seek a waiver while still protecting the U.S. industrial base.
* **GM accused of lobbying** : Cruz accused General Motors of supporting the provision in an effort to weaken Mercedes-Benz and make Cadillac more competitive in the domestic market.

# ["Late momentum"](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=208259137&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4MjU5MTM3LCJpYXQiOjE3ODQ5MTg2MDAsImV4cCI6MTc4NzUxMDYwMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.layu3z2z5CMgzTJBHVQ9uhuW6AGvuJWT74FqjrjUtyo)
### Political analyst Nate Silver weighed in on our campaign
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jul 24
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/late-momentum?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-restack-comment&action=restack-comment&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4MjU5MTM3LCJpYXQiOjE3ODQ5MTg2MDAsImV4cCI6MTc4NzUxMDYwMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.layu3z2z5CMgzTJBHVQ9uhuW6AGvuJWT74FqjrjUtyo&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/late-momentum?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends, I'm a geek.
It's true. Most people who've met me or who get this Substack aren't even a skosh surprised by that admission.
From manufacturing policy to jobs reports to voter data, I'm a gal who loves getting into the numbers. So I was especially interested when fellow numbers nerd Nate Silver published a whole deep-dive on our Senate race.
Nate Silver said, "Stevens has some late momentum," and cited a couple of polls that show we're leading the primary.
Let me nerd out for a minute and walk you through what he found, because I want this grassroots team to understand what's happening, especially with the primary in just 11 days. You deserve to see the numbers I'm seeing and know how I'm thinking about all of this.
**A new poll has us up by 7 points.** The Glengariff Group polled our primary for _The Detroit News_ and found us leading 48 to 41. That's good news because we're leading (obviously), but it's also important to note that this is an independent, A-rated pollster, and a 7-point lead.
**Mallory McMorrow 's supporters are joining this grassroots team in large numbers.** When Mallory suspended her campaign, the question was where her folks would go. And I want to say something directly to those folks, because I know some of you are reading this: Welcome. I know it's tough to have your candidate drop out, but I'm glad you're here. Mallory has been an important voice, both in this race and in the State Senate. She made me a better candidate, and I look forward to working with her in the future to build a stronger Michigan.
**The endorsements are coming. And I 'm grateful.** Senator Gary Peters, the man who's held this seat for 12 years, endorsed me to succeed him. And now Congressman Jim Clyburn - one of the most respected leaders in our party, a man who knows a thing or two about tough fights -- has endorsed this campaign too. I'm truly honored beyond words.
**The general election numbers are popping.** Looking at the highest-rated pollsters in Michigan, I'm beating MAGA Mike Rogers, while my primary opponent trails him. And that's similar to what _The Cook Political Report_ said: "If El-Sayed wins the primary, Democrats have little chance of holding the seat."
That's the state of the race, friends. Not according to me. According to the numbers and the people whose entire job and reputation is about trying to get this stuff right.
But **polls can only take you so far. They aren 't a prediction or a prophecy.**
These polls tell us we're headed in the right direction. But polls don't vote. Newsletters don't vote. And numbers nerds only get you so far.
People vote. And Michiganders are voting right now - ballots are filled out at kitchen tables across this state and going back in the mail as I type this. We are 11 days from the primary on Aug. 4. A day when so much will be decided. Which party has the best chance of controlling the Senate. Whether we can put a real check on Donald Trump. Whether we fight for reproductive freedom, Social Security, affordable gas and groceries, health insurance. Everything.
**I don 't want to wake up on Aug. 5 with a single regret, and I don't want you to either.** I want us to be able to say we put absolutely everything on the line when it mattered. That's what "late momentum" really is. It's not a permission slip to sit back, it's an assignment. A goal. A chance to show what this grassroots team is about.
Here's my ask: Will you help me build on this momentum? If you're able, chip in $20 or whatever you can to help us finish these last 11 days with our foot on the gas. Knocking on more doors, making more calls, getting more air time for our ads, and more of everything that got us here.
[CHIP IN](https://substack.com/redirect/8a75fba9-06c0-41c8-85d0-4432858bd150?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Let's give Nate Silver something to write about on Aug. 5. Let's tell the story of how our late momentum surged and how we're now on track to keep Michigan blue and flip the Senate.
I'm ready to get that newsletter.
More soon.
With grit,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

body:
It took me a long time to get this right
It took me a long time to get this right

| | | | Fellow Patriot, I'm going to be blunt with you, because the stakes are too high for anything less. Please read this entire message. It has taken me over an hour to write this as I collect my thoughts... **The radical Left is attempting a hostile takeover of the great state of Texas -- and they are funding it at a level that should alarm every freedom-loving American who reads these words.** _The Texas Tribune just confirmed it:**my far-left opponent, James Talarico, raised over $30 million in a single quarter**. That's more than triple what we raised._ **This is not an accident.** This is a coordinated, well-funded assault by the Democrat political machine -- the _same machine that has been working systematically_ , state by state, to dismantle the constitutional republic our Founders bled to build. They have targeted Texas because they know what we know _: if they flip this Senate seat, they flip the balance of power in Washington!_ These far-left political fanatics will spend as much as it takes. They'll flood Texas with cash to try to crush us. This is the playbook of people who do not believe in America. It is the playbook of those who hate America. **Remember:** They want wide-open borders. They want far-left control over our children's education. They want to pack the Supreme Court. They want Christianity gone. They want to silence dissent, crush opposition, and fundamentally transform this Nation into an unrecognizable nightmare, with malice towards every patriot who has ever stood and placed their hand over their heart... **They tried to destroy me with witch hunts. They failed.** **They tried to stop us in the primary. They failed.** **They raised $30 million to bury us.** **They will fail again --**_but only if you act right now!_ _**I need you to understand this**_**:** money in politics is not just money. It is air cover. It is television ads running in Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. It is field organizers knocking on doors in precincts across this state. Every dollar they raise that we do not match is a dollar spent convincing Texans to surrender their freedoms to Washington bureaucrats and far-left globalist interests. **We have raised $9 million since April. Here’s what’s going on right now in our fight to protect mifepristone access:
→ At the end of last year, the state of Louisiana sued the FDA to try to block this safe, legal medication from being prescribed by telehealth and delivered by mail.
→ After months of back and forth, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled in May to allow continued access to mifepristone nationwide while the case proceeds.
Now the case has returned to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit for a merits determination — a ruling on the actual substance of Louisiana’s claim — and I joined a coalition of 23 attorneys general in filing an amicus brief urging the court to issue a final ruling that protects lawful access to mifepristone.
Louisiana’s lawsuit attempts to reinstate a medically unnecessary requirement that mifepristone be dispensed in person — going against decades of scientific evidence.
Reinstating this requirement would create administrative chaos across the country, undermine states’ ability to protect access to reproductive care, and, critically, it would make it more difficult for individuals, especially in rural, low-income, and underserved communities, to access reproductive health care.
Bottom line: mifepristone is a safe, effective, and often lifesaving medication, and attempts to limit access to it are driven by a right-wing, anti-science political movement that’s determined to chip away at reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy nationwide.
I will keep fighting every day to protect reproductive freedom for all, and I want to know if you’re with me. Add your name if you agree that science — not politics — should guide medical decisions. Mifepristone has been FDA-approved for a quarter of a century, and safely used by an estimated 7.5 million people. California will never back down in the fight to protect access to this safe and legal medication, and to ensure medical decisions are made between doctors and patients — not politicians.
Thank you for being here.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/24/2026
body:
Colorado cut some kinship payments July 1 and told families to get certified. Some can’t.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey friends,
Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Court documents show Brandon Booth, accused of shooting a protester outside Aurora's ICE facility, admitted pulling the trigger but claimed he only meant to scare the women, though [he acknowledged they were unarmed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Denver Mayor Johnston unveiled a plan for [universal childcare and 20,000 homes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) despite hecklers. Littleton residents report [months of power outages](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and Colorado's [end of kinship caregiver payments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has left some families unable to qualify for certification. Colorado joined 24 other states and D.C. in [suing the Trump administration](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over new rules withholding a fifth of the state's counterterrorism grant money unless it meets five federal election conditions.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** After the Supreme Court struck down Trump's birthright citizenship order in Trump v. Barbara, Sen. Jim Banks [introduced a Citizenship Act](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) working within the ruling's exceptions. Separately, vandalism targeting Flock Safety's AI cameras [fueled surveillance debate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with Rep. Boebert citing her own FBI investigation to argue for [warrant requirements before tracking citizens](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Cory Gaines argues Colorado's Medicaid Commission is [chasing federal dollars instead of fixing spending](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Michael Hancock warns, via Brazil's example, that [courts risk assuming lawmaking power](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as Congress and presidents cede ground. And Naomi Riess, the GOP House District 59 candidate, cites [Colorado's 84 percent budget growth](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to argue for greater accountability against incumbent Katie Stewart.
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, July 24, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado cut some kinship payments July 1 and told families to get certified. Some can’t.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Jody Fountain testified before the Colorado Senate Appropriations Committee on April 14 with a story about a two-year-old boy.
The boy had been placed with his mother’s boyfriend. It was a kinship placement, the arrangement the state prefers when a child cannot stay with a parent. The boyfriend could not get certified as a foster parent. Something in his distant past disqualified him.
Years later, after Fountain adopted the boy, she read the disclosure file. Two weeks before the child was removed and put into foster care, the grandmother had called. The family had no money for food.
“I can’t help but think about all the children that are going to be placed in this situation as the support disappears for non-certified kin in the next few months,” Fountain told the committee.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado sues over Trump election rules tied to homeland security grants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Colorado joins two dozen other states in fighting new federal election-security safeguards attached to counterterrorism funding._
* **States push back on election security strings:** Colorado joined 24 other states and D.C. in suing DHS and FEMA over five election-integrity conditions — including citizenship verification of voters and poll workers, hand-marked paper ballots, and post-election audits — attached to 2026 Homeland Security Grant Program funding.
* **Feds cite real foreign threats:** DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin defended the requirements as necessary to guard against foreign interference and cyberattacks, a concern underscored when Trump declassified intelligence showing foreign actors, including a Chinese cyber actor, had obtained Colorado voter registration data.
* **Colorado already meets some standards:** The state's own attorneys general acknowledge Colorado already bars QR-code ballot tabulation, one of the five federal conditions, while the lawsuit instead argues DHS lacks legal authority to tie roughly $2.6 million in security funding to election administration and hasn't published the compliance guidelines it's requiring states to follow.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Southwest Colorado needs affordability, accountability and balanced representation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY NAOMI RIESS | COMMENTARY | JULY 23** _For more than three decades, I have worked with families, farmers, ranchers, property owners, small businesses and local governments across Southwest Colorado. I have helped people navigate land-use rules, permitting requirements, water issues and development approvals. Through that work, I have seen how government decisions made far from our communities can affect whether a family can build a home, whether a business can expand and whether a landowner can continue using property responsibly._
__
**[Federal audit questions nearly $54 million in Colorado Medicaid home-care payments](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JULY 22**
_Colorado can’t fully document millions of dollars it billed for Medicaid home care. That’s the finding of a new federal audit. The Office of Inspector General wants Colorado to return $8.07 million in federal money it says the state was not entitled to claim for personal care in a single budget year, the one ending June 30, 2024. Auditors questioned another $45.69 million and told the state to work it out with CMS._ __
**[Denver DSA member joined Cuba delegation now mentioned in State Department report](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY SHAINA COLE | NATIONAL | JULY 22** _Forty members of the Democratic Socialists of America flew to Cuba last October. They brought school and medical supplies. They toured a hospital and a primary school. Both of the organization’s national co-chairs went, along with nine other members of its governing body. One of them came from Denver._ __

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|

|
---

The Trump administration’s Department of Justice is trying to send me to prison for up to 17 years.
Why? Because I showed up to do my job.
Last year, I went to the Delaney Hall immigration detention facility in Newark for an official oversight visit. ICE escalated what should have been a routine oversight visit and wrongfully arrested the mayor of Newark, Ras Baraka.
Mayor Baraka’s charges were quickly thrown out. But Donald Trump’s DOJ set their sights on me, and baselessly charged me with crimes for my oversight work—for doing my job. These charges carry a sentence of 17 years in prison.
I am facing a vindictive and unjust prosecution. If you can, will you split a contribution between Equal Opportunity Now and me to help us stand strong against this weaponized DOJ, together? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-mciver]
CHIP IN TODAY! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-mciver]
Last month, my legal team argued before a three-judge panel at the Third Circuit Court of Appeals that this weaponization of the Department of Justice cannot stand. This administration is using the DOJ to do their personal bidding against the people they do not like. We are fighting for this case to be dismissed. We have civil rights groups, former January 6th prosecutors, and bipartisan former members of Congress standing with us.
We shouldn’t be spending taxpayer dollars to prosecute members of Congress for showing up to do their jobs. But because Washington is determined to push this case forward, I have to fight back with everything I have — for my family, for my constituents, and for our democracy.
I cannot fund this massive legal and political fight alone. Trump's DOJ has unlimited resources, but I have you.
Please stand with me and Equal Opportunity Now today. Click here to split a contribution between Equal Opportunity Now and me to help me fight back, protect our constitutional rights, and show Washington that New Jersey does not back down. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-mciver]

Thank you for standing with me in this fight.

LaMonica McIver

clean_body: I know what happens when working people aren't in the room. That's why I'm asking you to act today. | | | | | ---|--- I never planned to become a politician. I was a logger. Like my Dad, and his Dad before me. When big landowners started trying to screw workers out of fair wages, I spoke up. Politicians, including Susan Collins, said they'd listen. Too often, they didn't. That experience taught me something I’ve never forgotten: when working people don’t have a seat at the table, someone else makes the decisions for us. So I ran for a seat in the Maine legislature. For 20 years, including six as Senate President, I fought for working families. We expanded rural health care, protected union jobs, defended reproductive health care, and delivered real results for Mainers. The fight for working people doesn't end with one state or one election. It starts in Maine and runs through statehouses nationwide. subject: It’s no secret that the Supreme Court is corrupt

The Supreme
Court is corrupt. And thanks to Donald Trump and his billionaire backers,
it’s only gotten worse.

The Court has no binding ethics code. No real accountability. No
consequences. So the Justices just keep going:

🔴 They cave to Trump's abuse of the shadow docket — issuing
life-altering rulings on immigration, executive power, and federal
agencies with little to no explanation.

🔴 They accept undisclosed gifts from billionaire donors — luxury travel,
vacations, real estate deals — then rule on cases tied to those same
benefactors' interests.

🔴 They consistently side with corporations and political donors over
working people — gutting voting rights, weakening campaign finance laws,
shielding dark money donors, and green-lighting union-busting.

Trump and his megadonor network are the invisible hand steering this
Court.

Every ruling that guts a regulation, shields a donor, or hands
corporations a win traces back to the same small circle of billionaires
who bankrolled the Justices' seats — and now expect a return on that
investment.

It’s absurd, and we have to fight back before it's too late. But we can't
out-argue a rigged court — we have to out-organize them.

That's what Demand Justice PAC does. We’re tracking the lack of
accountability, exposing the cronyism, and fighting for the ethics rules
that the Court refuses to hold itself to.

But taking on the highest court in the land takes serious resources, which
is why we’re coming to you.

---

**CONCORD, N.H.** — Today, the Democratic National Committee voted to make South Carolina the first state on its presidential primary calendar. In response, New Hampshire Republican State Committee Chairman Scott Maltzie released the following statement:"The DNC continues to prove it has no respect for New Hampshire voters or our First-in-the-Nation primary,” said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie. "The good news for Granite Staters is that New Hampshire law, not the DNC, determines when our presidential primary is held.”"Republicans will continue fighting to protect our First-in-the-Nation primary because we know it gives voters the opportunity to meet candidates, ask tough questions, and play a unique role in choosing our nation's next president. That is something worth protecting."

clean_body: You can’t make this up. | Friends, we’re not exaggerating when we tell you that our candidates’ races come down to just a handful of votes. This year, three JanePAC-endorsed climate champions are running in districts that were decided by the slimmest of margins in 2024 — and these races could go either way in November, depending on the grassroots support we put behind them: | 1️⃣ Stephanie Vigil flipped Colorado House District 16 in 2022 and then lost this seat by just 3 votes in 2024. 2️⃣ Kari Rehrauer is running for re-election in Minnesota House District 35B — a swing seat that she won by just 280 votes in 2024. 3️⃣ Jen Fox ran for Minnesota House District 41B in 2024 and fell short by just 510 votes. These numbers should be a wake-up call for all of us. When races are decided by margins this thin, every voter reached, every door knocked, and every dollar raised can make the difference between winning and losing. **_VOTING ON ELECTION DAY_** Prefer to vote in person on August 11th? Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Find your polling place at [sos.vermont.gov/elections.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135935375/635800555/532353416?refcode=ea.4d6cc123-9487-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.4d6cc123-9487-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ5NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGQ2Y2MxMjMtOTQ4Ny1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0aPrzSiCYc0o04DyPpClgx-JrPT07dp_PNb975k7HG8=&emci=c1dbf27f-7a87-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=4d6cc123-9487-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=1745378) When you vote, you'll need to choose which party's primary ballot you want: Democratic, Republican, or Progressive. name: LeftAction
subject: Dear Canada: "Sorry Our President is an A-hole"
body:
Dear Canada: "Sorry Our President is an A-hole"
| | | | |
---
| | | **[Dear Canada:"Sorry Our President is an Asshole"](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te343d4bc-f394-4313-833d-9508ecf2fdad/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Dear Canada: Congratulations on the new Gordie Howe International [Bridge](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7fb6ebed-a399-4af3-a87f-2766a469ccfa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). It is a particularly apt and beautiful symbol of the many things that have connected our countries as friends and allies for more than 200 years. And we were going to have one hell of a party to celebrate its opening. **Unfortunately, our president is an A-hole.** [Sign the Letter Thanking Canada](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0aa081cf-4855-4f47-9cf5-1fd4c8e23630/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc1077f3e-a478-4df3-996d-bb02a7a5634d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Instead of simply enjoying the celebration, spending time with some of the world’s nicest people and maybe, just maybe, singing along with a song or two from Alanis Morissette, Donald Trump turned the bridge’s opening into yet another opportunity to threaten, insult and behave like a world-class asshole. Canada spent billions of dollars to build the bridge connecting Windsor and Detroit, a move that could have huge economic benefits for both cities. Trump responded by delaying its opening with a brand new and unhinged demand over a share of the revenue, and by launching a yet another reckless trade war. **[Because, as previously noted, he is an asshole.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td1f7cf7b-4496-4b20-97b8-ffb46d84f9b0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** But the rest of us, Americans from sea to shining sea, join together in thanking you for being such wonderful neighbors, steadfast friends and the source of approximately 98 percent of all our comedians. [Seriously, it’s unbelievable.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1efd62ed-c8a8-49d5-a841-a5753f036dc3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) And also for [stuff like this](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td102451f-29a4-41f4-961b-71c98203d3c4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) (hell yes, we remember) As for our asshole president, we’re sorry. Our countries are connected by far more than a bridge. We are neighbors, allies, trading partners and friends. Trump will eventually be gone. The bridge, and our friendship, will remain. **[So until then, thank you Canada. And sorry our president is such an asshole.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf54fb565-d222-40ca-9ddd-235d0bda6755/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

body:
[1]LeftNet

It’s Zohran Mamdani. A few months ago, we wound down our campaign
operations to focus on delivering results over the first few months of
this term.

We’re back.
Here’s why:

Progressives often use political campaigns as a tool to solely win (or
lose) elections. We build grassroots donor networks. We engage volunteers.
And come Election Day, we leave the campaign behind and start preparing to
govern. The emails stop coming.

But that is not how the big-money interests operate. Their work is
constant and prolific. In closed-door meetings, insider operatives
consider how to influence our politics year-round. That’s how our
opponents secured the resources to spend $83 million against our movement
last year.

There is a cynicism that our politics is permanently broken, that our
democracy can only favor the wealthy and well-connected. But I know that’s
not true. We just have to be willing to fight for it.

That’s why we’re making investments in our movement starting right now.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22925?t=1001&akid=1689%2E2118727%2ErRfV8d ]Will you sign up today so I can send you updates about how to help
defend our movement?

SIGN UP ››

We can expect that our opposition will be better funded, better organized,
and ready to spend earlier than before.

But now, we’re going to be ready.

By joining this movement, you’re helping us build an operation strong
enough to meet the fights ahead.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/go/22925?t=1002&akid=1689%2E2118727%2ErRfV8d ]I would be incredibly grateful if you would join our campaign
today. 🙏🏽

In solidarity,

Zohran Mamdani

Rocky for Kentucky [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP05/1/72103/images/29116e41-cc4b-4806-80ca-ee13275ddf2b.png]
Dear Peter,

I owe you a big thank-you.

It’s been an inspiring week announcing my campaign for governor of Kentucky. So many folks showed up in ways I am deeply grateful for. Whether you attended an event, chipped in, signed up to volunteer, shared our launch video with a friend, or simply took the time to read these emails, I'm so glad you're here.https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25]

Throughout my time in public service, I've met countless hardworking Kentuckians in every corner of our commonwealth. Those are the people who inspire what this campaign is really about: making sure every family has the opportunity to build a good life right here in Kentucky.

We're just getting started, and I know there will be tough days ahead. Here’s my promise to you as we go on this journey together:
I will fight to bring down the cost of living.
I will fight for our public schools.
I will fight for hospitals and health care in every corner of this commonwealth.
I will fight every bad policy — from Frankfort or Washington — that makes life harder for Kentucky families. I know how to win those fights because I’ve won them before.

And I will be a governor who answers to you. Not the powerful. Nobody but the people I serve.

Thank you for believing in this campaign. More than that, thank you for believing in Kentucky's future.

I'm proud to have you on this team.

And if you’d still like to be counted as a Founding Donor to our campaign, there's still time. You can use this personalized link, and your contribution will be counted right away: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25]

Thank you — more soon,

Rocky
Rocky Adkins has spent his life fighting for Kentucky. As a longtime Democratic leader in the Kentucky House of Representatives and Senior Advisor to Governor Andy Beshear, he's stood up for teachers, workers and families when it mattered most. When bad policies threatened Kentucky, Rocky took those fights head-on — and won.
Now he's running for Governor to lower costs, protect our schools and hospitals, defend our rights and keep fighting for Kentucky families. If you're ready for a governor who will always stand up for Kentucky, chip in today. Every dollar helps us reach voters across the commonwealth and build the grassroots campaign it will take to win. Modernizing this aging shipping terminal means improving the movement of goods, improving worker safety, expanding opportunities for maritime businesses, and supporting family-wage jobs for years to come.** This grant is also part of a much larger commitment to investing in Northwest Washington. **Since the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law was signed, I have helped secure more than $129 million in BUILD and RAISE grants for communities across Washington's Second Congressional District.** Those investments are improving roads, bridges, rail connections, ferry service, transit facilities, and freight infrastructure that people rely on every day. * Everett's Intermodal Yard improvements
* Lynnwood's Poplar Way Bridge
* A new electric hybrid ferry serving Lummi Island
* Rail safety improvements in Blaine
* The Port of Bellingham's Shipping Terminal Rail Connection Project

With the latest poll showing my opponent and me one point apart, I’m counting on your support in a significant way. Before sending this email, my team made sure I knew something important about you: You have the opportunity to make today the day you contribute to our campaign for the very first time. Every donation — even just $5 — makes a difference in the fight to keep New Hampshire blue. I’m counting on a few first-time donors to step up. Our campaign is fueled by people like you. Thanks for all that you do, Chris Pappas New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

| | Welcome to the first weekly email update of the 2026 cycle! We’ll use this email to keep you informed on where the campaign stands, highlight opportunities to get involved, and share the work being done across the district to keep this seat _**RED**_.

The months ahead will be busy, but they’re also the most important. Campaigns, especially close ones like here in NJ-07, will be won by folks who are willing to knock on one more door, make one more phone call, and have one more conversation with a neighbor. Every hour of work invested moves us one step closer to victory and holding the House Majority.

Thank you so much for being part of this team. We must work together to build momentum leading up to Election Day on November 3rd. We’re excited for what lies ahead - let’s get to work!

| | This past week, Tom announced that since taking office, he has helped return over $100 million to the residents of the Seventh District. Nearly $66 million comes from constituent cases while almost $39 million was secured from Community Project Funding.
“ _Delivering for the families and communities I represent is my top priority. Whether through Community Project Funding or constituent casework, I am committed to fighting for every available federal dollar and bringing New Jersey taxpayers’ money back home where it belongs.”_
**\- Congressman Tom Kean Jr.**

| | Earlier this week, we had a packed house at the NJ-07 Battle Station for RNC Chairman Joe Gruters. He rallied the Team Kean troops who came to make phone calls to get out the vote and spoke about the RNC’s commitment to making sure we **re-elected Tom and hold the Majority!**

Our campaign has been hitting the ground running, spreading our message to thousands of voters across the district. Since the Primary, we’ve been out canvassing across all six counties in partnership with county and local candidates. Just this past week, we have had door knocking teams in _**Bernards Twp., Fanwood, Franklin Twp., Green Brook, Long Hill, Mendham Borough, Mount Olive, New Providence, Oxford, Ogdensburg, Phillipsburg, Raritan Borough, Scotch Plains, Somerville, Springfield, Summit, and Westfield**_.

Throughout the summer, we also hold regular phone banks on a rotating basis at our County Headquarters. We have called over 90,000 voters since the start of this campaign all thanks to our dedicated group of volunteers! Want to join us? We’ll use this email to keep you informed on where the campaign stands, highlight opportunities to get involved, and share the work being done across the district to keep this seat RED. The months ahead will be busy, but they’re also the most important. Campaigns, especially close ones like here in NJ-07, will be won by folks who are willing to knock on one more door, make one more phone call, and have one more conversation with a neighbor. | | | | | | Hi Peter,
We had a great Treasurer’s Forum earlier this week in La Crosse! Thank you to the Young Democrats of Wisconsin, the 3rd Congressional District Democratic Party of Wisconsin, and the La Crosse County Democratic Party for hosting.
I appreciated the opportunity to share more about my experience, talk about my vision for using Public Power for the Public Good, and answer audience questions.
---
| |
[Wisconsin Public Radio published a great recap of the event,](https://us.list-manage.com/18F2s8hitdz?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09) including coverage of my proposal to create a State Budget Dashboard.
I’m excited to see this idea getting some more attention. I’ve been talking about this proposal since the beginning of this campaign, and it’s built on the work I did developing internal dashboards while working on Wisconsin Medicaid Programs. Our government should make it easy for people to understand exactly where their tax dollars go.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/hI5buxMMACI?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)

I’m the only statewide candidate who grew up in, lives in, works in, and serves in elected office in a rural Wisconsin community. Throughout this campaign, I’ve met voters of all ages in every corner of the state, and I’ll continue doing the work to earn their support through Election Day and beyond.
[**With less than three weeks until Election Day on August 11th, every conversation and every event matters! If you're able, will you make a contribution today to help us keep reaching voters across Wisconsin? Your support helps us stay on the road, connect with communities in every corner of the state, and build the coalition we need to win.**](https://us.list-manage.com/13IbC9v0Ujv?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)

name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: My birthday present
body:
The majority of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires who are out of touch with the struggles of our communities. | | |
---
Friend, Today is my birthday. And here’s what I want: a Congress that represents the people, not the billionaires. The majority of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires who are out of touch with the struggles of our communities. Instead of helping Americans with unaffordable healthcare, skyrocketing rent, and rising grocery and gas prices, many members of Congress consistently vote to spend our money on endless wars and genocide. **This week the U.S. House of Representatives passed the**** _National Defense Authorization Act_****, which also included the fascist-in-chief’s voter suppression bill: the**** _SAVE America Act_****.** This military spending bill is not final, but it includes the section that would merge the U.S. and Israeli militaries. The NHGOP Victory Report - 7/24/26

| | | | | | |
Dear Friend,
**A Note from the Chairman**

As we head into the second half of the summer, I wanted to take a moment to thank you for your continued support of the New Hampshire Republican Party. It's been an exciting few weeks as we continue laying the groundwork for a successful 2026 election cycle.Our team has been hard at work strengthening election integrity efforts, preparing for the Midterm Convention, engaging with candidates across the state, expanding our communications, and connecting with communities through events and grassroots outreach. While much of this work happens behind the scenes, it is all focused on one goal: building the strongest possible Republican organization for the fights ahead.I'm also pleased to share that our social media presence continues to grow. Increasing our digital reach has been a major priority, and we're seeing encouraging gains in engagement across our platforms. If you haven't already, be sure to follow us on social media and share our posts with your friends and family. Every like, share, and comment helps us reach more Granite Staters and amplify our message.Thank you for being an important part of our team. Together, we'll continue building momentum and delivering Republican victories across New Hampshire.
**Social Media**
Be sure to follow us on social media so you can keep up to date on all the exciting things the party has to offer! We encourage you to share our posts so that we can continue to reach more people!

**YouTube:** [https://www.youtube.com/@NH_GOP](https://us.list-manage.com/L0QjeXgkTqy?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=gcN-wgUqPGWB1fDNHhtNpdMxrPmHwHJy_qowt_FncrbPKrtDXThnXjtzuA==) (NH_GOP)

Check out our 4th of July recap video![https://fb.watch/IzugB6Q2I7/?mibextid=wwXIfr](https://us.list-manage.com/1ANzVwuiwgD?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=coOmWPthKjDxU4opr4rlvvKpO3dbVlLeKoKEvIhn5rEK1CL0cJRKf0I89w==)

Stay tuned for a July recap of our busy month!

Mai is the daughter of Hmong refugees, born and raised in Sacramento. Mai’s parents fled war in Laos and arrived in California to find a new life.

## Mom of Two Starts Law School at 47
Abigail Seymour spent most of her career behind a camera. But a nagging feeling never went away. In her twenties, she walked the 485-mile Camino de Santiago across Spain alone, and the experience left her with a conviction that she could handle anything. Decades later, she kept driving past Elon University School of Law in her North Carolina town and thinking, "[_It's right there_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAQAL_G7jbCa2yeC4rXpMu1V1obsxgiDBZw4fL3p9wvXD3SaDSft_VGPvi4f9DB2u52rTatkVsJXCvn9eGPVN2r-VgcU67FUNx83PcVBc4gFKBcDfnwWmVvtGVGHnvWg_onF5QKsXfaEFmaNxqXYbrfUTHKDQeBdhzYTmrpvX7bhEKJAiccLjSgnNS8LHa2SJvopGDja8qXR_KxOrbhlZ6cL1s6-qBdrWfpxv8dXju8npzOwG_U4bWlgyI0l6BUypUNBGpQNpdSAKogFcTUIDCZAo4zpBaBQoCWDo5gfT6Av7fwVfyTYUCBYhrHPmtzNh-CL7PqpNgP8uE3pv754lPjTwAAAP__dtqJew)." At 47, with two kids at home, she enrolled. Her sister died during her first year, and she nearly dropped out. She failed the bar twice. After the second attempt, her therapist told her, "_Everything you want is on the other side of comfort_." On her third try, she passed. Today, Abigail, 59, runs Camino Law, a bilingual, all-women family law firm in Greensboro with seven employees. In 2024, she was named one of North Carolina _Lawyers Weekly's_ [50 Most Influential Women](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAQhJ8GOiN7MYdQuEhDd9OmRHvsNeyVf5CxrsXbR5xXSDma0Wjm-_u1fSEHTvsfjGT87rfq85aoXYFqpbJ9c8z1uBun6yAs9XKYLKd930DCS8hZgN4ccrg33TvjiYDGnoyaf-kF9AzQH2ZZ1Cidcko7je_Zwduid-NbaYmS_NSzedrkDBokTKAGVKCn-bUs_uUBrey0JMc1l-E7c6oH-XDnHyqDzbEP5qj1vLrxdwdrB2trbTjLc6JxoSfSwfpIUSgQXnR1sFqMnLII2ETLkZIo5Mhz4rQLj5HD_fHOgrayJcFJpFzqISyWHDihGCWAnhRMw1Fj6ItxZ-MQ-HrNnZZ7RA6fefW_uf4Y-BcAAP__QGWRKA). "_I found a job, and I created one for seven other people,_ " she said. "_There's a real pride in that_."
## Teen Saves Woman With Dementia
Royal Cothrun, 14, was riding his bike through Gilbert, Arizona, when he spotted 75-year-old Teresa Morgan walking alone in 103-degree heat. [She looked confused](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu2zAQRE8jdTSoNSVahYo06n7alMJaXJL7QZEGtTHhnD5QrpB6BoN579fX9oWcOIefeNDig9_Ely1TOxOJUN2--SgSP43zGQmrnA7zzjmEDTRMSlsFZnPI6bOZ3i2eCOje0zLYh5nBWIA-Lg4tGDt7nHeD8Lwbuxu3P2AcJhjxgT0v15q2YEDDCMMNBzCjnebZTx5w153R5FhKvX0XzhLJp095U73t5ejTEkVeZ3f_0cHawdpau-FzH8Yr7WC9cDpYf78Se-EcFFb-UzJ2sAZOT6qihCirWHKp5JQvVUVKr6tKyVFNH9XKgVk1lqgcHZSFUXFWg9bKUahEKhJKXxf3apwSn5PtjA4Hcvr3Uf5b7nuBvwEAAP__OoySjA). He stopped. "_She just looked like something was wrong, so I started talking to he_ r." Teresa had recently been diagnosed with dementia and had wandered miles from home after a trip to the grocery store. Royal guided her to a shaded spot, then helped her [remember her son's phone number](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQAL8GOiOz2BAKF6-hy2uvRJt4jTcydmScWNzXn3K_cP1oNJqv63pFDhy3_7iTcZtbi0trpHoEKoXy-uA9FX9WjocnzOWwGO8ct20FCaOQkwC1WuRwrqq1xhEBDS2ZfrqoGdQE0HqjL1ZbPdI8ktRSkr7RPCAN2s76Nlls2XxscgIFEjT0Hfag9DTOsxsd4F02SpLlknL3SByLJxfO9Kbc3dPeBuNLeR7N8K-BpYGl1tq9njXl4s8P0MDSK3ESZpGCFZj5O0UUt3SKA990iJp2jKJy8cLSTrEwCpde0YqK0VLmuAmOopdDEp6wNLC02dhn5RD4GKdGyW1HDr815c8b3wZ-AgAA__9Kyoqi). He called her son, Jeff, who raced to the scene before paramedics arrived. "_Just so lucky, so fortunate that he ran across her and he cared enough to stay with her and to take care of her_ ," Jeff said. A Gilbert Fire Department captain said the outcome "would have been much, much worse" without Royal's quick thinking. Royal's mom said she was proud but not surprised that he stopped to help Teresa, saying that helping people has always been a part of who her son is.
## Meet Jimothy, Seattle's Favorite Raccoon
Kiana Hall thought she was filming a cat. She and her husband were walking through Seattle's Ballard neighborhood when she spotted something scooting out from beneath a parked car. It turned out to be a raccoon with an unusually short neck and a perfectly round body. She had [never seen anything like it](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAQRL8GOiNYO-AULq6hy7VXWgtew0bGjowF4u9POeUPrhtppBm99_OwD-TAcfnGjYxfvC0-2UjnHqgUyvbJWyrrdXLcV8Jcdodx5rgsFlroRTsIUNYhh8uq2hlPBCRrMt2g1R3UAFCvRna9pK53UmsJOCklaULvpCZ0fqKpZvNeawdQ0MINugY7ULehv9997wHntlItOS4pN8_Esazkw5UOys2ctjqYtZTXXsmvCsYKxvM8m5IcXu-2gvGNU8G4pOTEJ3-wRMZ5TimKnbCUQOLgjEEc7CiJPEe8ad1pVWfjXieHwHs_VKpdNuTwd13-7eww8BsAAP__fJ-D9g). Kiana posted the video to Instagram, naming him "Jimothy" because "_he looked like a Jimothy_." Within days, the clip had more than 7 million views. Wildlife experts say his appearance is likely the result of a [congenital spinal deformity](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFutDAUhE9jOpB5GLwULv7GxS_tpkiR0nLwM7yVsRE4a3H7iOQIaaYZaWa--bibu6VAcX7YFZWfvck-mYjlCJgz7uZJa8rLWSgeC9o9H87GieI8G-Aw1FzWIIyzFE4jKqc8ImBXoWrlTYwgJEC1KO7RInZ-HLBF7vnw6dub932PDhyXoiJ1pXEJAjj00Da2BdHLYRz94MFOnAmOjnLam2eimBf04Uwv3JsprVVQS87bwbp_DDQDXUppvja6PAb6zTnzwHIw0FcJA80lA91e8o4254D1bqcppVj__6Wtj42iDbVDn_aV8slAC95eTDB2sucMdLUrtxUKgY5BMsHn1VL4mZP__ONLwXcAAAD__5zOhnU), but he appears to be thriving in the wild. Seattle has fully embraced him. The Mariners briefly changed their profile picture to Jimothy in a team hat. A local artist painted a mural. A tattoo shop has booked [Jimothy-inspired tattoos](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGunDAQheGnMZ1XMBi8LijS0N20KdFgxjAbY6_syaJ9-2ijvMGtf-lI3_n1tXwhR077TzxpCntYJOQl0VUjiVBZHnxmOd4Xp3oQFqkbJs9p3xdoYdSt1WCWDTm-F9NsUyAC6huaOns3DowFaI6pD7b3m3PGrgMF6-6ddzig8xt4GHFtePqstRYMtDBAd8MOzGBH58IYAH2rTEsbSy63R-YkB4X4zi8qN5_PJk6HyLOq_oeCWcF8XdftN6d9-FQFMxZhH0nB_IEpmGP2GBXMLy4YdUHvc076P1Vzqk8uVPX555MFRXKuGtOmK6FIJP0s2Uc8UTgnBTPcOz0aG4bgjQ7eDdqsYdOra1dtEXsXaL0Pbm3KtD0vjpHraJVp9xM5_iPIt79_TfA3AAD__xNGm3o). A Seattle city councilmember plans to present a proclamation commemorating "Jimothy Summer."

#
Peter —
On Wednesday, the House voted 216 to 214 to put more than $70 billion behind Trump's war with Iran. Then they got on planes and left Washington for a month.
Here is what they did not do. Not Wednesday, not in the months this war has been running: vote to formally authorize it. Not once. They will vote to pay for it. They will not vote to own it.
Congress voted on Iraq. Congress voted on Afghanistan. They at least went on the record. Every member who sent this country's troops into those wars had to put their name next to it and answer for it afterward — and we made sure they did. These cowards won’t even do that.
But here is the part we really need you to sit with: 216 to 214.
Two votes. If two more members had voted no, that vote fails. Two seats is the whole margin — and a number of the people who voted yes are sitting in districts they barely hold.
That is the answer here. Not a strongly worded letter. Not waiting for them to grow a conscience over recess. Beating them in November and taking back the House.
That's what VoteVets does, and it's what we're raising money to do right now.

This week, [David Shuster](https://open.substack.com/users/16891317-david-shuster?utm_source=mentions) counts down five clips that cover the waterfront: Spain's big win gets an ending nobody at FIFA saw coming, a Lego AI walks through the poll numbers that have the White House sweating, and Steve Scalise--who insists you can't get pasta at Olive Garden without a photo ID--finds out what that policy feels like in practice.
Then Mr. Neuberger delivers a doo-wop tribute to Todd Blanche, the man tasked with making the Epstein files disappear, and four very familiar voices close the show with a barbershop number you'll be humming into November. Six minutes, five clips, and one assignment: check your voter registration, because many states cut it off 30 days before the midterms.
Watch to the end.

# [Mamdani's Marxist circus is already gutting NYC and the bond market is next](https://substack.com/redirect/11f78216-93a8-485e-a5b9-2c3bf996bbba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
204 days of this socialist clown show and the smart money is already sprinting for the exits. Corporations and the ultra-rich are bolting while the man-child mayor insists everything is fine. Tax base is rotting. Muni bonds are starting to stink. He calls capital flight "fearmongering." Pure delusion. This is how cities go broke.
* **Winners?** Florida, Texas, and every low-tax state vacuuming up the producers. Anyone short NYC paper who saw this coming a mile away.
* **Losers?** NYC taxpayers left holding the bag, bondholders staring at rising yields and default risk, and every sucker still voting for this experiment.
* **Next?** Yields keep climbing, more HQs vanish, rating agencies finally wake up, and the financing noose tightens. Capital flight accelerates like it always does.

This is the exact same movie we called in **["California gifts its Fortune 500 crown to Texas while plotting its self-destruction"](https://substack.com/redirect/526f6308-9f29-49a9-8598-4c892cc755df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and **["California's richest are flooding Florida's quiet Gulf Coast."](https://substack.com/redirect/54136292-09aa-45b0-843d-33988890cdd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Punish the people who create the wealth and they leave. The parasites stay. The books explode. Mamdani thinks reality is optional. Reality is about to send him a very large invoice. Short the bonds. Long the escape routes.

# [Intel just crushed its fastest growth in 15 years on AI demand. Didn't matter, the market still kicked it in the teeth](https://substack.com/redirect/11f78216-93a8-485e-a5b9-2c3bf996bbba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
$16.1 billion revenue, up 25%, fastest since 2011. 42 cents EPS versus 21 cents expected. Data center $6.3 billion, up 59%. Foundry $5.8 billion, up 31%. Client $8.9 billion, up 13%. Gross margin back to 42%. Guidance beats again. AI is finally forcing this dinosaur to print real money. Shares still got smoked though. Wall Street never misses a chance to hate a winner.
* **Winners?** Anyone who held through the rebuild, Lip-Bu Tan's turnaround crew, and hyperscalers finally getting more supply. Foundry customers who stopped waiting for miracles.
* **Losers?** The shorts who kept calling the recovery fake and every tourist who panicked during the July 28% bloodbath.
* **Next?** Capex climbs next year. Demand still outruns supply. If the process tech holds, this becomes a multi-year rerating after the noise dies.

The AI boom just handed Intel its best quarter in a generation and the market still treated it like a punchline. Demand is real. Margins are expanding. Long-term deals are locking. Capital flows to the people who actually ship silicon, not the people who write the hot takes **(except me!)** Intel is back in the fight. Bet the producers.
* * *

# [Samsung and SK Hynix just locked the memory racket with fat US AI contracts](https://substack.com/redirect/11f78216-93a8-485e-a5b9-2c3bf996bbba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Memory is still the purest money printer in the AI buildout and the Koreans are about to cash the biggest checks. Samsung and SK Hynix are inking very large long-term supply deals with the US tech giants during the Korean president's Silicon Valley visit. US firms already drive 80-90% of the orders. This feeds Seoul's $880 billion chip and data-center war chest. Exactly as we said it would.
* **Winners?** Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, and every fund that loaded the HBM/DRAM complex early. Hyperscalers who secured supply before the rest woke up.
* **Losers?** Every device maker, PC OEM, and AI wannabe still buying spot at inflated prices. Small electronics outfits are already dead men walking.
* **Next?** Deals drop this week, capacity ramps, prices stay elevated deep into 2027, and the big three keep printing while the weak bleed out.

This fully validates the call in **["Wall Street crowns Micron the next Nvidia."](https://substack.com/redirect/95f46e68-afe6-4cc2-880d-f23aa62efdd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Samsung and SK Hynix as co-winners on the shortage that mints money while everyone else pays up or dies. The later $2 trillion carnage flushed the tourists. Now the strong lock multi-year contracts and compound. Buy the memory complex. This is not a trade. This is a structural goldmine for the people who control the bottleneck.

# [Airbus is designing the future while Boeing is still trying to keep the doors on](https://substack.com/redirect/11f78216-93a8-485e-a5b9-2c3bf996bbba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At Farnborough Airshow in the UK Airbus dropped its "wing of tomorrow". Longer, lighter, folding, up to 30% fuel savings with tests starting this year and a next-gen A320 successor aimed at the second half of the 2030s. Boeing meanwhile is still in the recovery ditch: trying to push 737 production from 38 to 47 a month (70% of their cash flow), praying for MAX 7 and MAX 10 certification this year, and telling airlines that what they really want is better versions of the old planes. One side is playing offense. The other is still digging out.
* **Winners?** Airbus shareholders and any airline that wants real efficiency gains. Engine makers who can sell to both camps.
* **Losers?** Boeing's production constraints and every carrier still waiting for Seattle to get its act together on a clean new narrowbody.
* **Next?** Airbus keeps the technology narrative. Boeing either hits the rate and stabilizes quality or keeps watching share erode. Production numbers will decide.

Airbus is already designing the next decade. Boeing is still fighting to make the current one reliable (and keep the doors from blowing out.) Capital prefers the side that is moving forward while the other is still apologizing for the past. Watch the rates and the fuel claims, those decide who owns commercial aviation profits. The rest is noise.

Didn't matter, the market still kicked it in the teeth | | | Jul 24 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- 204 days of this socialist clown show and the smart money is already sprinting for the exits. Corporations and the ultra-rich are bolting while the man-child mayor insists everything is fine. Tax base is rotting. Muni bonds are starting to stink. He calls capital flight "fearmongering." Pure delusion. This is how cities go broke. Winners? Florida, Texas, and every low-tax state vacuuming up the producers. Anyone short NYC paper who saw this coming a mile away. Losers? NYC taxpayers left holding the bag, bondholders staring at rising yields and default risk, and every sucker still voting for this experiment. Next? Yields keep climbing, more HQs vanish, rating agencies finally wake up, and the financing noose tightens. Capital flight accelerates like it always does. This is the exact same movie we called in and Punish the people who create the wealth and they leave. The parasites stay. The books explode. Mamdani thinks reality is optional. Reality is about to send him a very large invoice. Short the bonds. Long the escape routes. Sponsored by: | | ---|---|--- A former advisor to the CIA and Pentagon just released an AI Black Paper. It's going viral, because if he is right... It means - as soon as July 29th at 6:30 PM - the entire system could go down. And it's going to start with the massive bubble popping in AI . $16.1 billion revenue, up 25%, fastest since 2011. 42 cents EPS versus 21 cents expected. Data center $6.3 billion, up 59%. Foundry $5.8 billion, up 31%. Client $8.9 billion, up 13%. Gross margin back to 42%. Guidance beats again. AI is finally forcing this dinosaur to print real money. Shares still got smoked though. Wall Street never misses a chance to hate a winner. Winners? Anyone who held through the rebuild, Lip-Bu Tan's turnaround crew, and hyperscalers finally getting more supply. Foundry customers who stopped waiting for miracles. Losers? The shorts who kept calling the recovery fake and every tourist who panicked during the July 28% bloodbath. Next? Capex climbs next year. Demand still outruns supply. If the process tech holds, this becomes a multi-year rerating after the noise dies. The AI boom just handed Intel its best quarter in a generation and the market still treated it like a punchline. Demand is real. Margins are expanding. Long-term deals are locking. Capital flows to the people who actually ship silicon, not the people who write the hot takes (except me!) Intel is back in the fight. Bet the producers. Memory is still the purest money printer in the AI buildout and the Koreans are about to cash the biggest checks. Samsung and SK Hynix are inking very large long-term supply deals with the US tech giants during the Korean president's Silicon Valley visit. US firms already drive 80-90% of the orders. This feeds Seoul's $880 billion chip and data-center war chest. Exactly as we said it would. Winners? Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, and every fund that loaded the HBM/DRAM complex early. Hyperscalers who secured supply before the rest woke up. Losers? Every device maker, PC OEM, and AI wannabe still buying spot at inflated prices. Small electronics outfits are already dead men walking. Next? Deals drop this week, capacity ramps, prices stay elevated deep into 2027, and the big three keep printing while the weak bleed out. This fully validates the call in Samsung and SK Hynix as co-winners on the shortage that mints money while everyone else pays up or dies. The later $2 trillion carnage flushed the tourists. Now the strong lock multi-year contracts and compound. Buy the memory complex. This is not a trade. This is a structural goldmine for the people who control the bottleneck. The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication, we exist for you, because of you! At Farnborough Airshow in the UK Airbus dropped its "wing of tomorrow". Longer, lighter, folding, up to 30% fuel savings with tests starting this year and a next-gen A320 successor aimed at the second half of the 2030s. Boeing meanwhile is still in the recovery ditch: trying to push 737 production from 38 to 47 a month (70% of their cash flow), praying for MAX 7 and MAX 10 certification this year, and telling airlines that what they really want is better versions of the old planes. One side is playing offense. The other is still digging out. Winners? Airbus shareholders and any airline that wants real efficiency gains. Engine makers who can sell to both camps. Losers? Boeing's production constraints and every carrier still waiting for Seattle to get its act together on a clean new narrowbody. Next? Airbus keeps the technology narrative. Boeing either hits the rate and stabilizes quality or keeps watching share erode. Production numbers will decide. Airbus is already designing the next decade. Boeing is still fighting to make the current one reliable (and keep the doors from blowing out.) Capital prefers the side that is moving forward while the other is still apologizing for the past. Watch the rates and the fuel claims, those decide who owns commercial aviation profits. The rest is noise. Let us know your thoughts. * You're currently a free subscriber to . clean_body: We have the chance to elect 25 Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot in Michigan this year | = Michigan is a purple state, and this cycle that’s truer than ever before, Peter. Every major statewide office — including the governorship — is up for grabs this November. So is every seat in the Michigan state House and state Senate. And with Democratic Sen. Gary Peters retiring, one of the most critical U.S. Senate seats in the country is now wide open. There’s no doubt about it: Michigan is a critical battleground. That’s why EMILYs List is proud to endorse 25 Democratic pro-choice women running up and down the ballot in Michigan this year — including Haley Stevens for U.S. Senate. Haley will be a fierce advocate for Michiganders. And her race is one of our most important opportunities to keep this seat blue and put Democrats on the path to taking back the Senate majority. = | = Michigan is a critical battleground. We can’t take a single seat for granted or leave any race up to chance. Mike Rogers is the GOP’s favored candidate for this open Senate seat — and defeating him won’t be easy. He came within just 19,000 votes of winning Michigan’s other U.S. Senate seat in 2024. Now, he’s back and more determined than ever. With a large cash-on-hand advantage, he’s preparing to spend big to try and drown Haley out during the final months of the general election. Michigan families deserve a leader who will fight to lower costs, create good jobs, expand access to affordable housing, and protect reproductive healthcare. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135938067/635809955/828285645?refcode=email_072426_story-RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDQ0ZmI2Yy05ZTg3LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KsHoAxGe8jI6pldAAad6HKJ8_ufxkg24qh8xFWvkRL0=) Derek, I want to tell you a story about the first time I ran for statewide office. An election that changed the future of Pennsylvania — in both good ways, and bad. **If you already know about who I am, what I’ve delivered, and what I’m still fighting for,**[**please use this link to chip in to my reelection campaign. Every donation makes a difference in a battleground state like Pennsylvania.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135938068/635809956/-2014140140?refcode=email_072426_story-RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDQ0ZmI2Yy05ZTg3LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KsHoAxGe8jI6pldAAad6HKJ8_ufxkg24qh8xFWvkRL0=) But if you have a free minute, I hope you’ll keep reading. Nearly ten years ago, on November 8th, 2016, millions of Pennsylvanians made their way to the polls. Their pick for President that year? Voters chose Donald Trump by the slimmest of margins. But Pennsylvania’s pick for Attorney General? It was me. That’s right, Derek: **On the same night Donald Trump won Pennsylvania — and changed the future of our country for the worse — we won the A.G.’s office.** Immediately, the contrast was apparent. In Washington, Donald Trump led with chaos, cruelty, and corruption. But here in Pennsylvania? We weren’t focused on petty, partisan distractions. We rolled up our sleeves and got to work. And in my time as Attorney General? We went toe-to-toe with insurance companies to protect access to affordable care for nearly 1.9 million western Pennsylvanians. We negotiated a $1 billion settlement against Big Pharma companies that profited off the opioid crisis. We took Donald Trump and his allies to court 43 times in the aftermath of the 2020 election. _And we won every single time._ I’ll be honest: I see a lot of parallels between that election, and this one coming up on November 3rd. No, Donald Trump isn’t on the ballot this time. But his chosen candidate – along with his toxicity, partisanship, and cruelty – is, Derek. That’s why I need to personally ask: [**Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can ahead of our next fundraising deadline on July 31st?
